(bathtub). 2) Chọn từ đối nghĩa (4 câu): full ↔ empty / tidy ↔ untidy / hot oven ↔ cold fridge / turn on ↔ turn off. 3) Nghe tô màu (Flyers Listening Part 5): Colour the fridge green. / Write 'FULL' on the box. / Colour the knife and fork yellow. 4) Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu) – tìm 5 điểm khác giữa 2 tranh nhà bếp và phòng tắm (cô là giám khảo, từng em; cô nói 1 câu về tranh của cô, con nói điểm khác trong tranh của con): Cô: In my picture, the fridge is full. – Con: In my picture, the fridge is empty. / Cô: In my picture, there's a knife on the table. – Con: In my picture, there's a fork. / Cô: In my picture, the oven is on. – Con: In my picture, the oven is off. / Cô: In my picture, the bathtub is empty. – Con: In my picture, the bathtub is full of water. / Cô: In my picture, there's a comb next to the mirror. – Con: In my picture, the comb is in the bin.
column15: The Empty Fridge — On Sunday morning, Anna opens the fridge. It's empty! 'Let's go shopping,' says Dad. They take the lift down to the shop. When they come home, the fridge is full. Dad puts a pizza in the oven. Anna gets the knives and forks. 'Delicious!' says Leo. After lunch, he puts the paper in the bin and washes his hands at the faucet.
column16: In the Kitchen (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — In the kitchen, in the kitchen, / where's the fork? Where's the fork? / Next to the knife, next to the knife, / on the plate, on the plate! / Is the fridge full? Is the fridge full? / No, it's empty! No, it's empty!

column19: 打扫房子 — 星期天，Xiaomei一家打扫房子。爸爸打扫厨房，他把盘子放在冰箱旁边。妈妈打扫洗手间，她关好水龙头。Xiaomei打扫走廊和她的卧室。现在家里很干净！ (Xīngqītiān, Xiaomei yìjiā dǎsǎo fángzi. Bàba dǎsǎo chúfáng, tā bǎ pánzi fàng zài bīngxiāng pángbiān. Māma dǎsǎo xǐshǒujiān, tā guānhǎo shuǐlóngtóu. Xiaomei dǎsǎo zǒuláng hé tā de wòshì. Xiànzài jiā li hěn gānjìng!)
column20: 打扫歌 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 打扫厨房，打扫厨房，洗盘子，洗盘子。关好水龙头，关好水龙头，真干净，真干净！ (Dǎsǎo chúfáng, dǎsǎo chúfáng, xǐ pánzi, xǐ pánzi. Guānhǎo shuǐlóngtóu, guānhǎo shuǐlóngtóu, zhēn gānjìng, zhēn gānjìng!)

column16: Our Home Song (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — The lift in our building goes up and down, / up and down, up and down. / The lift in our building goes up and down, / all day long! / The fridge in our kitchen is full of food… / The bathtub in our bathroom is full of water…
column17: 公寓 gōngyù, 楼 lóu, 层 céng, 电梯 diàntī, 住 zhù, 卧室 wòshì, 空调 kōngtiáo, 暖气 nuǎnqì, 电灯 diàndēng, 干净 gānjìng, 厨房 chúfáng, 冰箱 bīngxiāng, 盘子 pánzi, 打扫 dǎsǎo, 洗手间 xǐshǒujiān, 浴缸 yùgāng, 水龙头 shuǐlóngtóu, 走廊 zǒuláng, 门口 ménkǒu, 钥匙 yàoshi, 信封 xìnfēng, 搬 bān
column18: 1) Đọc truyện 新家的钥匙, chọn câu trả lời (YCT4 đọc hiểu, 4 câu): 他们住几层？(十层) / 谁开车送他们？(叔叔) / 钥匙在哪儿？(信封里) / 晚上大家做什么？(打扫公寓). 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: 1 bạn nói câu tiếng Anh, bạn kia nói tiếng Trung (6 câu mẫu của unit). 3) Mini test unit: viết chữ Hán điền chỗ trống: 我的卧室( 里 )有一张桌子 / 我们坐( 电梯 ) / 请关( 水龙头 ). 4) YCT口试（中级）第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; con nhìn tranh, chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói một đoạn 4–5 câu): tranh 'ngày chuyển nhà' – câu mẫu: 今天我们搬家了。新家在十楼，我们坐电梯上楼。叔叔开车送我们。钥匙在信封里。晚上大家一起打扫房间，房间很干净。(Jīntiān wǒmen bānjiā le. Xīn jiā zài shí lóu, wǒmen zuò diàntī shàng lóu. Shūshu kāichē sòng wǒmen. Yàoshi zài xìnfēng li. Wǎnshang dàjiā yìqǐ dǎsǎo fángjiān, fángjiān hěn gānjìng.)
column19: 我理想的家 — Anna画了她理想的家：“我的家有二十层，楼里有电梯。我的卧室里有一张大桌子和很多书。厨房里有一个大冰箱，冰箱里都是冰激凌！”Leo笑着说：“谁来打扫？” (Anna huàle tā lǐxiǎng de jiā: “Wǒ de jiā yǒu èrshí céng, lóu li yǒu diàntī. Wǒ de wòshì li yǒu yì zhāng dà zhuōzi hé hěn duō shū. Chúfáng li yǒu yí gè dà bīngxiāng, bīngxiāng li dōu shì bīngjīlíng!” Leo xiàozhe shuō: “Shéi lái dǎsǎo?”)
column20: 电梯上上下下 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus) — 我们的电梯上上下下，上上下下，上上下下。我们的电梯上上下下，到十楼！ (Wǒmen de diàntī shàngshàng xiàxià, shàngshàng xiàxià, shàngshàng xiàxià. Wǒmen de diàntī shàngshàng xiàxià, dào shí lóu!)

Nhan has got sunglasses and new trainers. At the door, the teacher says, 'Take off your gloves and come in!' Everyone laughs and dances.
column16: What Are You Wearing? (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — I am wearing sunglasses, / sunglasses, sunglasses. / I am wearing sunglasses / and a pair of gloves! / She is wearing a pretty crown… / He is wearing a belt and tie…

column19: 下雪了 — 下雪了，Xiaomei要出去玩儿。妈妈说：“穿上夹克衫，戴上手套和围巾！”Xiaomei穿着牛仔裤和夹克衫出去了。回家以后，她脱了手套和夹克衫，喝了一杯热牛奶。 (Xià xuě le, Xiaomei yào chūqu wánr. Māma shuō: “Chuānshang jiákèshān, dàishang shǒutào hé wéijīn!” Xiaomei chuānzhe niúzǎikù hé jiákèshān chūqu le. Huí jiā yǐhòu, tā tuōle shǒutào hé jiákèshān, hēle yì bēi rè niúnǎi.)
column20: 穿衣歌 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 穿上衬衫，穿上衬衫，打领带，打领带。戴上手套围巾，戴上手套围巾，出去玩，出去玩！ (Chuānshang chènshān, chuānshang chènshān, dǎ lǐngdài, dǎ lǐngdài. Dàishang shǒutào wéijīn, dàishang shǒutào wéijīn, chūqu wán, chūqu wán!)

column14: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn đúng (6 câu): a spotted dress / a striped tie / spotted pyjamas / a striped belt / red spots / green stripes. 2) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu) – hỏi – đáp trao đổi thông tin (cô là giám khảo; cô có thẻ 'Anna's shop', con có thẻ 'Leo's shop'; con hỏi theo gợi ý trên thẻ rồi trả lời câu cô hỏi): Con hỏi: What's the name of Anna's shop? – Spots and Stripes. / What can you buy there? – Pyjamas and ties. / How much does the necklace cost? – It's 60 yuan. / Is there a discount? – Yes, 10%. / Thank you. – You're welcome. Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: What does Leo's shop sell? – Coats and gloves. / How much is the coat with fur? – It's 300 yuan. / Is there a discount? – No, there isn't. / Can you buy clothes online? – Yes, you can. 3) Nghe và tô màu (Flyers Listening Part 5): Colour the stripes on the T-shirt blue. / Draw spots on the pyjamas. / Write '20%' on the discount sign.
column15: The Spotted Pyjamas — Leo needs new pyjamas. He and Dad take the lift to the shop on the third floor. There's a big discount today. 'I prefer the striped ones,' says Leo. 'How much do they cost?' asks Dad. 'They're 90 yuan, but the spotted ones are cheaper,' says the salesperson. Leo chooses the striped pyjamas. 'Thank you!' 'You're welcome!'
column16: At the Shop (giai điệu London Bridge Is Falling Down) — How much does this T-shirt cost, / T-shirt cost, T-shirt cost? / Striped or spotted, which is best? / Thank you! – You're welcome!
column17: 种 zhǒng, 合适 héshì, 换 huàn, 旧 jiù, 售货员 shòuhuòyuán, 打折 dǎzhé, 更 gèng | Ôn: 衬衫 chènshān, 围巾 wéijīn, 手套 shǒutào, 钱 qián, 块 kuài, 电梯 diàntī
column18: 1) Nghe giá chọn tranh (YCT4 nghe, 4 câu): 这件衬衫八十块。/ 那条围巾三十块。/ 牛仔裤打折，一百块。/ 手表比围巾更贵。 2) Viết câu so sánh theo tranh giá (4 câu): 衬衫比领带更贵。/ 围巾比手套更便宜。... 3) Đóng vai售货员 – khách: 这件多少钱？/ 不合适，可以换吗？/ 可以。
column19: 换衬衫 — Leo买了一件新衬衫，可是太大了，不合适。他和妈妈去商店。Leo问售货员：“可以换一件吗？”售货员说：“可以。这种更小，你试试。”这件很合适，Leo很高兴。 (Leo mǎile yí jiàn xīn chènshān, kěshì tài dà le, bù héshì. Tā hé māma qù shāngdiàn. Leo wèn shòuhuòyuán: “Kěyǐ huàn yí jiàn ma?” Shòuhuòyuán shuō: “Kěyǐ. Zhè zhǒng gèng xiǎo, nǐ shìshi.” Zhè jiàn hěn héshì, Leo hěn gāoxìng.)
column20: 多少钱 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 多少钱呀？多少钱呀？这件衬衫，这件衬衫。今天商店打折，今天商店打折，更便宜，更便宜！ (Duōshao qián ya? Duōshao qián ya? Zhè jiàn chènshān, zhè jiàn chènshān. Jīntiān shāngdiàn dǎzhé, jīntiān shāngdiàn dǎzhé, gèng piányi, gèng piányi!)

column19: 准时出发 — 星期六Xiaomei的班要去公园野餐。老师说：“我们早上八点准时出发。”天气预报说下午会下雨，一定要带雨伞。他们在公园玩儿了一会儿，下午真的下雨了，可是大家都带了雨伞。 (Xīngqīliù Xiaomei de bān yào qù gōngyuán yěcān. Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen zǎoshang bā diǎn zhǔnshí chūfā.” Tiānqì yùbào shuō xiàwǔ huì xià yǔ, yídìng yào dài yǔsǎn. Tāmen zài gōngyuán wánrle yíhuìr, xiàwǔ zhēn de xià yǔ le, kěshì dàjiā dōu dàile yǔsǎn.)
column20: 一会儿下雨 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 一会儿下雨，一会儿下雨，带雨伞，带雨伞。我们准时出发，我们准时出发，不怕雨，不怕雨！ (Yíhuìr xià yǔ, yíhuìr xià yǔ, dài yǔsǎn, dài yǔsǎn. Wǒmen zhǔnshí chūfā, wǒmen zhǔnshí chūfā, bú pà yǔ, bú pà yǔ!)

What are they doing while it is raining?): Cô: In my picture, it's raining. – Con: In my picture, it's sunny. / Cô: In my picture, there are two umbrellas. – Con: In my picture, there are three umbrellas. / Cô: In my picture, it's 3 p.m. – Con: In my picture, it's 5 p.m. / Cô: In my picture, there's a storm. – Con: In my picture, there's a rainbow. / Cô: In my picture, the children are playing football. – Con: In my picture, they're reading books.
column15: The Storm at Night — Last September, Nhan's family went somewhere new: a beach in the south. At 9 p.m., there was a big storm. While the wind was blowing, they played cards inside. 'Is this a problem?' asked Nhan. 'No problem. The forecast says it will stop soon,' said Dad. In the morning, it was warm and sunny, and there was a rainbow over the sea.
column16: Somewhere Warm (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — When it's freezing, zero degrees, / let's go somewhere warm, please! / While it's raining, no problem, / soon a rainbow, look at them! / Warm and sunny, twenty-five, / what a comfortable day outside!

column20: 祝贺你 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 祝贺你呀，祝贺你呀，得第一，得第一。Nhan跑得最快，Nhan跑得最快，真棒啊，真棒啊！ (Zhùhè nǐ ya, zhùhè nǐ ya, dé dì-yī, dé dì-yī. Nhan pǎo de zuì kuài, Nhan pǎo de zuì kuài, zhēn bàng a, zhēn bàng a!)

'No problem!' laughs Leo, and everyone claps.

Leo (watches / is watching) a cartoon now. / I (watch / am watching) a quiz programme every Friday. / Shh! Anna (is watching / watches) a comedy. / We (turn off / are turning off) the TV at nine o'clock every night. 3) Đóng vai theo cặp: Please turn on the TV. – OK! / What's on channel 3? – An interesting quiz programme.
column15: Who Chooses Tonight? — Every evening, the family watches TV together. Dad likes the news, Leo likes cartoons and Anna likes quiz programmes. Tonight everyone wants to choose. 'Channel 1 has the news!' says Dad. 'Channel 5 has a wonderful cartoon!' says Leo. 'Channel 7 has an interesting quiz!' says Anna. Then Mum turns off the TV and smiles. 'Tonight we're playing a quiz game in the living room!' Everyone laughs.
column16: What Are You Watching? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — What are you watching? What are you watching? / I'm watching TV, I'm watching TV. / Cartoons every Sunday, the news every evening, / Turn it off! Turn it off!

column19: 今天晚上看什么？ — 每天晚上，一家人一起看电视。爸爸喜欢看新闻，Leo喜欢看卡通片，Anna喜欢看电视竞猜。今天晚上，大家都想选择。爸爸说：“看新闻吧！”Leo说：“卡通片更有趣！”Anna说：“我想看竞猜！”妈妈关掉电视，笑着说：“今天晚上我们在客厅里玩竞猜游戏！”大家都笑了。(Měi tiān wǎnshang, yì jiā rén yìqǐ kàn diànshì. Bàba xǐhuan kàn xīnwén, Leo xǐhuan kàn kǎtōngpiàn, Anna xǐhuan kàn diànshì jìngcāi. Jīntiān wǎnshang, dàjiā dōu xiǎng xuǎnzé. Bàba shuō: “Kàn xīnwén ba!” Leo shuō: “Kǎtōngpiàn gèng yǒuqù!” Anna shuō: “Wǒ xiǎng kàn jìngcāi!” Māma guāndiào diànshì, xiàozhe shuō: “Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen zài kètīng lǐ wán jìngcāi yóuxì!” Dàjiā dōu xiào le.)

column5: Brave Xiaomei — In the evening, Xiaomei is doing her science homework. Then the lights go off. Her little brother is worried and unhappy. 'Don't worry,' says Xiaomei. 'Look out of the window. What a surprise! The moon is big and round.' 'Are you sure it's the moon?' 'Yes, I'm sure!'

column9: [Ngữ pháp: 正在 (đang làm) và 每天 (thói quen)] 我正在做数学作业。(Wǒ zhèngzài zuò shùxué zuòyè.) / 弟弟正在看卡通片，他每天都看。(Dìdi zhèngzài kàn kǎtōngpiàn, tā měi tiān dōu kàn.) / 动作片里的男孩很勇敢。(Dòngzuòpiàn lǐ de nánhái hěn yǒnggǎn.) / 今天的月亮很圆，大家都很惊奇。(Jīntiān de yuèliang hěn yuán, dàjiā dōu hěn jīngqí.)
column10: 勇敢的Xiaomei — 晚上，Xiaomei正在认真地做科学作业。突然，电灯关了。弟弟很害怕。Xiaomei很勇敢，她说：“别怕！看，窗户外面有圆圆的月亮。”弟弟很惊奇：“月亮真亮！”(Wǎnshang, Xiaomei zhèngzài rènzhēn de zuò kēxué zuòyè. Tūrán, diàndēng guān le. Dìdi hěn hàipà. Xiaomei hěn yǒnggǎn, tā shuō: “Bié pà! Kàn, chuānghu wàimiàn yǒu yuányuán de yuèliang.” Dìdi hěn jīngqí: “Yuèliang zhēn liàng!”)

(unkind / interesting) / Grandpa reads the ___ every morning. (newspaper / postcard) / I'm writing a ___ to my cousin. (postcard / magazine) / 'Are you ___?' – 'Yes, I am.' (sure / unusual). Phương án nhiễu thêm: envelope / key / fridge. 2) Hiện tại đơn hay tiếp diễn – chia động từ (4 câu): Grandpa (read) the newspaper every morning. / Right now he (read) a magazine. / Listen! The phone (ring). / We (post) a postcard to Grandma every holiday. 3) Đóng vai: Are you sure? – Yes, I'm sure. / Can you post this postcard for me? – No problem! 4) Flyers Nói phần 1 (mẫu) – tìm 5 điểm khác giữa 2 tranh phòng khách (từng em): Cô: In my picture, Grandpa is reading a newspaper. – Con: In my picture, he's reading a magazine. / Cô: In my picture, the TV is on. – Con: In my picture, the TV is off. / Cô: In my picture, there's a postcard on the table. – Con: In my picture, there's an envelope. / Cô: In my picture, the phone is ringing. – Con: In my picture, Mum is talking on the phone. / Cô: In my picture, the girl looks worried. – Con: In my picture, she looks happy.
column15: The Postcard Surprise — Nhan is unhappy. His best friend Leo is on holiday and he isn't writing. 'Maybe he's unfriendly now,' says Nhan. Mum says, 'Don't be unkind. Maybe he's busy.' The next morning, Grandpa is reading the newspaper. 'Nhan, there's post for you!' It's a postcard from Leo: 'I'm on a beach. It's wonderful! I miss you.' What a surprise! Nhan isn't worried now. He writes a postcard back and Grandpa posts it.
column16: The Postcard Song (giai điệu London Bridge) — I've got a postcard in the post, in the post, in the post. / I've got a postcard in the post. What a surprise! / Grandpa reads the newspaper, newspaper, newspaper. / Grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.

column18: 1) Nhìn tranh chọn từ (dạng YCT4 nhìn tranh – chọn, 6 câu): 报纸 / 杂志 / 圆 / 响 / 勇敢 / 惊奇 (phương án nhiễu: 公寓 / 厨房 / 领带). 2) Điền 正在 hoặc 每天 vào câu (4 câu): 爷爷___早上看报纸。/ 现在他___看杂志。/ 你听，电话___响。(正在) / 我___都做作业。 3) Đọc to và nói theo tranh: 今天的月亮很圆！/ 动作片里的男孩很勇敢。/ 电话响了！
column19: 勇敢的弟弟 — 晚上，爷爷正在看报纸，Xiaomei正在认真地做作业。突然，电话响了，声音很大。弟弟有一点儿害怕，可是他很勇敢，他去接电话。是奶奶！奶奶说：“看窗户外面，今天的月亮很圆！”大家都很惊奇：“真漂亮！”(Wǎnshang, yéye zhèngzài kàn bàozhǐ, Xiaomei zhèngzài rènzhēn de zuò zuòyè. Tūrán, diànhuà xiǎng le, shēngyīn hěn dà. Dìdi yǒu yìdiǎnr hàipà, kěshì tā hěn yǒnggǎn, tā qù jiē diànhuà. Shì nǎinai! Nǎinai shuō: “Kàn chuānghu wàimiàn, jīntiān de yuèliang hěn yuán!” Dàjiā dōu hěn jīngqí: “Zhēn piàoliang!”)
column20: 电话响了 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 电话响了，电话响了，叮铃铃，叮铃铃。爷爷正在看报纸，我正在看杂志，快来接！快来接！(Diànhuà xiǎng le, diànhuà xiǎng le, dīnglínglíng, dīnglínglíng. Yéye zhèngzài kàn bàozhǐ, wǒ zhèngzài kàn zázhì, kuài lái jiē! Kuài lái jiē!)

column15: The Dark Evening — It's a stormy evening. Leo is watching a wonderful action film. Then the lights go off and the TV turns off. Leo is worried. 'Where's the torch?' Dad finds a flashlight in the kitchen and turns it on. 'The wifi isn't working,' says Mum. 'We can't watch our programme online.' So Anna starts a quiz: 'What's red, round and in your fridge?' 'A tomato!' says Leo. The family plays quiz games by torchlight. 'This is more interesting than TV!' says Leo.
column16: Turn On the Torch (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat) — Turn, turn, turn it on, turn the torch on, please! / No TV and no wifi, the lights are off tonight. / Turn, turn, turn it off, turn the torch off, please! / The lights are on, the TV's on, everything's all right!

column19: 下大雨的晚上 — 晚上下大雨，Leo正在看动作片。突然，电灯和电视都关了。Leo有一点儿担心。爸爸打开手机的灯。妈妈说：“我们上不了网，也不能发电子邮件。”Leo问：“我们怎么跟奶奶联系？”爸爸说：“我知道奶奶的电话号码！”他们给奶奶打电话，然后一起玩竞猜游戏。Leo说：“这比看电视更有趣！”(Wǎnshang xià dà yǔ, Leo zhèngzài kàn dòngzuòpiàn. column15: The School Concert — Xiaomei gets an invitation in an envelope: 'Come to our school concert on Saturday at seven p.m.!' There are lots of instruments at the concert: a piano, violins, drums and a very big bass. First, the children play together in an ensemble. Then Xiaomei's brother plays a drum solo. He plays very well! Last, Anna plays a happy tune on her violin. She plays beautifully. 'What a wonderful performance!' says Mum.
column16: Play Your Instrument (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — Leo plays the drums so well, drums so well, drums so well. / Leo plays the drums so well, boom, boom, boom! / Anna plays the violin, violin, violin. / Anna plays the violin beautifully! / Come and play a happy tune, happy tune, happy tune. / Come and play a happy tune at our school concert!

Xīngqīliù wǎnshang qī diǎn, xuéxiào yǒu yǎnchū! Yǎnchū de shíhou, yǒu gāngqín, tíqín, gǔ, hái yǒu hěn dà de dīyīn tíqín. Tóngxuémen xiān yìqǐ hézòu, hěn hǎotīng. Ránhòu dìdi dǎ gǔ, dǎ de fēicháng hǎo! Zuìhòu, Anna lā tíqín, lā de hěn hǎotīng. Māma shuō: “Jīntiān de yǎnchū zhēn jīngcǎi!”)
column20: 弹钢琴 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎) — 弹钢琴呀，弹钢琴呀，弹得好，弹得好。哥哥打鼓咚咚，姐姐拉琴真好，听一听！听一听！(Tán gāngqín ya, tán gāngqín ya, tán de hǎo, tán de hǎo. Gēge dǎ gǔ dōngdōng, jiějie lā qín zhēn hǎo, tīng yi tīng! Tīng yi tīng!)

column5: The Invitation — Xiaomei lives on the fifth floor. Today she gets an envelope. Inside, there is an invitation and two tickets for the school concert on Saturday at seven p.m. Her brother is playing a drum solo! 'How much are the tickets?' asks Xiaomei. 'They're free. They're from the school!' says Mum.

column8: Mới: 两张票 liǎng zhāng piào / 今晚的演出 jīnwǎn de yǎnchū / 一共多少钱 yígòng duōshao qián / 一万人 yí wàn rén

column10: 信封里的票 — Xiaomei住在五楼。今天她收到一个信封。信封里有两张票！是学校星期六晚上七点的演出。弟弟要打鼓。Xiaomei问妈妈：“两张票一共多少钱？”妈妈笑着说：“不要钱，是学校送的！”(Xiaomei zhù zài wǔ lóu. Jīntiān tā shōudào yí gè xìnfēng. Xìnfēng lǐ yǒu liǎng zhāng piào! Shì xuéxiào xīngqīliù wǎnshang qī diǎn de yǎnchū. Dìdi yào dǎ gǔ. Xiaomei wèn māma: “Liǎng zhāng piào yígòng duōshao qián?” Māma xiàozhe shuō: “Bú yào qián, shì xuéxiào sòng de!”)

column10: 看京剧 — Leo和爸爸坐电梯去看京剧。台上有一个有名的演员，他的衣服很漂亮。演员们演得很精彩。看完以后，爸爸给Leo讲京剧的故事。Leo很惊奇：“京剧真有趣！”(Leo hé bàba zuò diàntī qù kàn jīngjù. Tái shang yǒu yí gè yǒumíng de yǎnyuán, tā de yīfu hěn piàoliang. Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi. Kàn wán yǐhòu, bàba gěi Leo jiǎng jīngjù de gùshi. Leo hěn jīngqí: “Jīngjù zhēn yǒuqù!”)

column13: Mới: actor, actress, costume, stage (theatre), speak, conversation, borrow, keep | Ôn: cartoon, comedy, interesting, surprise, magazine, telephone, worried, p.m. (for time), glove
column14: 1) Đọc định nghĩa, viết từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 1, 5 câu): This man acts in films or plays. (actor) / This woman acts in films or plays. (actress) / You wear this in a play. (costume) / Actors stand on this in a theatre. (stage) / You do this when you use your friend's thing for a short time. (borrow) 2) Chọn câu trả lời đúng (dạng Flyers Reading Part 2, 4 câu): Can I borrow your violin? – (Sure! / Yes, I do.) / Do you like Beijing Opera? – (Yes, I love it! / It's on Saturday.) / How well does she speak Chinese? – (Very well. / She is ten.) / What's on TV tonight? – (A comedy. / I'm sure.) 3) Đóng vai ở nhà hát: Excuse me, where's the stage? – It's over there. / The actors performed very well! – Yes, they did! 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu) – trao đổi thông tin về 2 buổi hòa nhạc (cô là giám khảo; cô có thẻ 'Leo's concert', con có thẻ 'Anna's concert'): Con hỏi: Where is Leo's concert? – At the theatre. / When is it? – On Saturday at 7 p.m. / What instrument does Leo play? – The drums. / How much is a ticket? – 50 yuan. / Is it interesting? – Yes, it's wonderful! Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: Where is Anna's concert? – In the park. / What time is it? – At 4 p.m. / What does Anna play? – The violin. / Who are the actors? – Her classmates. / Can you borrow a costume? – Yes, you can.
column15: Behind the Stage — Nhan is an actor in the school play. Before the play, he can't find his costume! He is very worried. He speaks to his friend Anna. 'Can I borrow your hat?' 'Sure,' says Anna. 'But please keep it carefully.' Then the actress in the play finds his costume behind the stage. What a surprise! The play is a comedy. Nhan and the actress have a funny conversation on the stage. Everyone laughs. 'The actors performed very well!' says the teacher.
column16: On the Stage (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Actors, actors on the stage, / In your costumes, what a show! / You speak well and you sing well, / You perform so beautifully! / Actors, actors on the stage, / Thank you for a wonderful show!
column17: Mới: 演员 yǎnyuán, 讲 jiǎng, 互相 hùxiāng, 招待 zhāodài, 借 jiè, 公斤 gōngjīn | Ôn: 搞笑片 gǎoxiàopiàn, 有趣 yǒuqù, 有名 yǒumíng, 惊奇 jīngqí, 杂志 zázhì, 联系 liánxì, 电梯 diàntī, 盘子 pánzi, 打扫 dǎsǎo
column18: 1) Đọc và chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 他是一个很有名的___。(演员) / 爸爸给我___京剧的故事。(讲) / 同学们要___帮助。(互相) / 我可以___你的提琴吗？(借) / 这个鼓有三___。(公斤) Phương án nhiễu: 打折 / 网购 / 领带. 2) Nói theo tranh với bổ ngữ 得 (3 câu): 演员们演得很精彩。/ 他讲得很清楚。/ 妈妈招待客人招待得很好。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你喜欢京剧吗？——喜欢，京剧很有趣！/ 我可以借你的书吗？——可以。
column19: 台上的Nhan — Nhan是学校演出的演员。演出以前，他找不到他的衣服，很着急。他给Anna打电话：“我可以借你的帽子吗？”Anna说：“可以！”这时候，另一个演员在台后面找到了他的衣服。大家都很惊奇！在台上，Nhan和她互相讲笑话，大家都笑了。老师说：“演员们演得很精彩！”(Nhan shì xuéxiào yǎnchū de yǎnyuán. Yǎnchū yǐqián, tā zhǎo bu dào tā de yīfu, hěn zháojí. Tā gěi Anna dǎ diànhuà: “Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de màozi ma?” Anna shuō: “Kěyǐ!” Zhè shíhou, lìng yí gè yǎnyuán zài tái hòumiàn zhǎodàole tā de yīfu. Dàjiā dōu hěn jīngqí! Zài tái shang, Nhan hé tā hùxiāng jiǎng xiàohua, dàjiā dōu xiào le. Lǎoshī shuō: “Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi!”)
column20: 小演员 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 小演员，小演员，在台上，在台上。互相帮助很好，讲个故事真好，真精彩！真精彩！(Xiǎo yǎnyuán, xiǎo yǎnyuán, zài tái shang, zài tái shang. Hùxiāng bāngzhù hěn hǎo, jiǎng gè gùshi zhēn hǎo, zhēn jīngcǎi! Zhēn jīngcǎi!)

column5: Borrowing a Violin — Nhan wants to play in the concert, but he hasn't got a violin. He calls Anna on the telephone. They have a short conversation. 'Can I borrow your violin?' column10: 借提琴 — Nhan想参加演出，可是他没有提琴。他给Anna打电话：“我可以借你的提琴吗？”Anna说：“可以！”提琴不重，只有一公斤。Nhan很认真地拿着提琴。演出以后，他说：“谢谢你！我拉得很好！”(Nhan xiǎng cānjiā yǎnchū, kěshì tā méiyǒu tíqín. Tā gěi Anna dǎ diànhuà: “Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de tíqín ma?” Anna shuō: “Kěyǐ!” Tíqín bú zhòng, zhǐ yǒu yì gōngjīn. Nhan hěn rènzhēn de názhe tíqín. Yǎnchū yǐhòu, tā shuō: “Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ lā de hěn hǎo!”)

column5: The Heavy Piano — It's the day of the concert. The piano isn't on the stage. 'Can someone push it?' asks the teacher. No-one moves. Then Leo and a few friends push it together. 'What else can we do?' asks Leo. 'You can play a few songs!' says the teacher. Leo hates waiting, so he plays the drums at once!

Gāngqín bú zài tái shang, lǎoshī wèn: “Shéi néng bāngmáng?” Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué mànman de tuī gāngqín. column12: Buổi dạy 27. Unit 6 · Music and Cinema – Âm nhạc và điện ảnh (3/4): a few, no-one, 除了, 地; ôn không tranh
column13: Mới: push, hate, else, a few, no-one | Ôn: instrument, drum, violin, tune, concert, invitation, solo, performance, actor, actress, costume, borrow, warm, May, forecast
column14: 1) Chọn từ đúng (4 câu): (A few / No-one) friends help Leo push the piano. / (No-one / A few) can play the drums as well as Leo. / What (else / few) can you play? / I (hate / keep) loud music. 2) Ôn không tranh – nghe mô tả, nói từ (5 câu): It's big and you hit it. (drum) / You play it with your fingers. It's black and white. (piano) / It's small and you hold it under your chin. (violin) / You wear it in a play. (costume) / You get it before a party or a concert. (invitation) 3) Kể lại truyện 'The Heavy Piano' theo 4 tranh, mỗi tranh 1 câu có trạng từ (slowly, well, beautifully, loudly).
column15: The Heavy Piano — It's the day of the big concert. The piano isn't on the stage. 'Can someone push it?' asks the teacher. No-one moves. Then Leo and a few friends push it slowly together. 'What else can we do?' asks Leo. 'Can you play a few songs before the concert?' says the teacher. Leo hates waiting, so he plays the drums at once. The composer of the concert songs is there too. He smiles. 'This boy plays very well!'
column16: No-One Plays Like You (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat) — Push, push, push the piano, push it to the stage! / A few friends and you and me, push it all the way! / Play, play, play a tune, play it very well! / No-one plays the drums like you, ring the concert bell!
column17: Mới: 除了 chúle, 讨厌 tǎoyàn, 地 de | Ôn: 钢琴 gāngqín, 弹钢琴 tán gāngqín, 提琴 tíqín, 鼓 gǔ, 演出 yǎnchū, 票 piào, 演员 yǎnyuán, 互相 hùxiāng, 借 jiè, 暖和 nuǎnhuo, 凉快 liángkuai, 一定 yídìng, 换 huàn
column18: 1) Hoàn thành câu với 除了……以外，还…… (3 câu): 除了钢琴以外，我还会___。/ 除了唱歌以外，Anna还会___。/ 除了Leo以外，还有谁打鼓？ 2) Chọn 的 / 地 / 得 (4 câu): 大家高兴___唱歌。(地) / 他唱___非常好。(得) / 我___提琴很旧。(的) / 弟弟慢慢___走。(地) 3) Ôn không tranh – cô nói câu, con giơ thẻ chữ: 钢琴 / 提琴 / 鼓 / 低音 / 演员 / 票.
column19: 很重的钢琴 — 今天有一个很大的演出。钢琴不在台上。老师问：“谁能帮忙？”大家都不说话。Leo和几个同学慢慢地推钢琴。老师问：“除了钢琴以外，你们还会什么？”Leo说：“我还会打鼓！”Leo讨厌等，他马上高兴地打鼓。作曲家也在那儿，他笑着说：“这个孩子打得真好！”(Jīntiān yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yǎnchū. Gāngqín bú zài tái shang. Lǎoshī wèn: “Shéi néng bāngmáng?” Dàjiā dōu bù shuōhuà. Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué mànman de tuī gāngqín. Lǎoshī wèn: “Chúle gāngqín yǐwài, nǐmen hái huì shénme?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ hái huì dǎ gǔ!” Leo tǎoyàn děng, tā mǎshàng gāoxìng de dǎ gǔ. Zuòqǔjiā yě zài nàr, tā xiàozhe shuō: “Zhège háizi dǎ de zhēn hǎo!”)
column20: 除了钢琴 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎) — 除了钢琴，除了钢琴，还有鼓，还有鼓。大家高兴地唱，大家快乐地跳，真好听！真好听！(Chúle gāngqín, chúle gāngqín, hái yǒu gǔ, hái yǒu gǔ. Dàjiā gāoxìng de chàng, dàjiā kuàilè de tiào, zhēn hǎotīng! Zhēn hǎotīng!)

column10: Leo生病了 — 早上，Leo不想起床。妈妈问：“你怎么了？”Leo说：“我头疼，还咳嗽。”妈妈带他去看医生。医生说：“你发烧了，应该吃药，多休息。不用打针。”Leo很高兴：“谢谢医生！”(Zǎoshang, Leo bù xiǎng qǐchuáng. column14: 1) Nghe và chọn A/B/C (dạng Flyers Listening Part 4, 4 câu): What's the matter with Leo? (A flu ✓ / B a broken arm / C a toothache) / What should he take? (A medicine ✓ / B a bath / C a photo) / What does the boy wash his hair with? (A soap / B shampoo ✓ / C water) / What are soft? (A his shoes / B his pyjamas ✓ / C his books) 2) Ghép vấn đề với lời khuyên should / shouldn't (5 cặp): I've got a headache. – You should have a rest. / I've got flu. – You should see a doctor. / My hands are dirty. – You should wash them with soap. / I've got a stomach-ache. – You shouldn't eat ice cream. / I'm tired. – You should go to bed. 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: What's the matter with you? – I've got a cough and a fever. – You should take some medicine. – Thank you, doctor! – You're welcome. Phương án nhiễu trong tranh: necklace / bracelet / sunglasses.
column15: A Busy Day at the Doctor's — Today the doctor is very busy. Leo has got flu. 'You should take this medicine and have a rest,' says the doctor. Xiaomei's brother has got a stomach-ache. 'You shouldn't eat so much ice cream!' Nhan injured his knee and there is a little blood. The nurse washes it with soap and water. 'Are you ready? This won't hurt.' Then she puts on a soft bandage. 'Thank you!' says Nhan. 'You're welcome!' says the nurse. 'Be careful next time!'
column16: What's the Matter? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — What's the matter? What's the matter? / I've got flu. I've got flu. / You should take some medicine, you should have a rest now, / Get well soon! Get well soon!
column17: Mới: 头疼 tóuténg, 咳嗽 késou, 应该 yīnggāi, 打针 dǎzhēn, 拉肚子 lā dùzi, 受伤 shòushāng, 小心 xiǎoxīn, 流汗 liú hàn | Ôn: 医生 yīshēng, 药 yào, 健康 jiànkāng, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 戴 dài, 更 gèng, 合适 héshì, 脱 tuō
column18: 1) Nghe và chọn tranh (dạng YCT4 nghe – chọn tranh, 5 câu): 头疼 / 咳嗽 / 拉肚子 / 受伤 / 打针. 2) Ghép vấn đề với lời khuyên 应该 / 不应该 (4 cặp): 我头疼。– 你应该休息。/ 我咳嗽，还发烧。– 你应该去看医生。/ 我拉肚子了。– 你不应该吃冰淇淋。/ 我流了很多汗。– 你应该洗澡。 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: 你怎么了？——我头疼，还咳嗽。——你应该吃药，多休息。——谢谢医生！——不客气！ Phương án nhiễu: 围巾 / 牛仔裤 / 衬衫.
column19: 医生很忙 — 今天医生很忙。Leo发烧了，医生说：“你应该吃药，多休息。”Xiaomei的弟弟拉肚子了，医生说：“你不应该吃那么多冰淇淋！”Nhan踢足球的时候受伤了。护士帮他洗干净，说：“不用打针，没关系。”Nhan说：“谢谢！”护士说：“不客气！下次要小心！”(Jīntiān yīshēng hěn máng. Leo fāshāo le, yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi.” Xiaomei de dìdi lā dùzi le, yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín!” Nhan tī zúqiú de shíhou shòushāng le. Hùshi bāng tā xǐ gānjìng, shuō: “Bú yòng dǎzhēn, méi guānxi.” Nhan shuō: “Xièxie!” Hùshi shuō: “Bú kèqi! Xià cì yào xiǎoxīn!”)
column20: 你怎么了 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎) — 你怎么了？你怎么了？我头疼，我头疼。你应该去休息，你应该吃点药，早点好！早点好！(Nǐ zěnme le? Nǐ zěnme le? Wǒ tóuténg, wǒ tóuténg. Nǐ yīnggāi qù xiūxi, nǐ yīnggāi chī diǎn yào, zǎo diǎn hǎo! Zǎo diǎn hǎo!)

His coach is pleased.

column15: Lazy Nhan and Grandma's Secret — One morning, Nhan is lazy. He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. He goes to the sports hall for a football match. He runs too fast and gets hurt. A kind doctor gives him an x-ray. 'It isn't broken, but you shouldn't play football this week.' Nhan is interested in the x-ray picture. In the same hospital, Grandma is in bed. 'You should speak in a low voice here,' says the nurse. Grandma's glasses are missing! Nhan finds them under her bed. 'I've got a secret,' says Grandma. 'I'm going home tomorrow!' Nhan is very pleased.
column16: Should and Shouldn't (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — You should brush your teeth each day, teeth each day, teeth each day. / You should brush your teeth each day, don't be lazy, no! / You shouldn't shout in hospital, hospital, hospital. / Speak in a low voice in hospital, shh, shh, shh!

column18: 1) Đọc và chọn từ (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 早上要刷牙、洗___。(脸) / 做作业不应该___。(马虎) / 冬天很___感冒。(容易) / 真___，我的眼镜在哪儿？(奇怪) / 这个声音很___，是爷爷！(熟悉) Phương án nhiễu: 旗袍 / 售货员 / 夹克衫. 2) Hoàn thành câu với 疼得受不了 (3 câu): 我的牙___。/ 他的脚___。/ 弟弟的头___。 3) Nói theo tranh với 应该 / 不应该 (4 tranh): 你应该每天刷牙。/ 在医院里不应该跑。/ 你不应该吃很多冰淇淋。/ 你应该戴眼镜看书。 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; 2 câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 问题1：生病的时候，你应该做什么？(Shēngbìng de shíhou, nǐ yīnggāi zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 生病的时候，我应该去看医生，好好吃药。我应该多喝水，多休息。我不应该吃冰淇淋。(Shēngbìng de shíhou, wǒ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng, hǎohāo chī yào. Wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi. Wǒ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) / 问题2：你每天早上做什么？(Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 我每天早上六点起床，刷牙、洗脸，然后吃早饭。七点我和妈妈一起去学校。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, shuāyá, xǐ liǎn, ránhòu chī zǎofàn. Qī diǎn wǒ hé māma yìqǐ qù xuéxiào.)
column19: 马虎的Nhan — Nhan早上很马虎，他不刷牙，也不洗脸，就去体育馆比赛。比赛的时候，他跑得太快，受伤了，脚疼得受不了。医生说：“踢足球很容易受伤，你这个星期不应该踢足球。”在医院里，Nhan看见了奶奶。奶奶说：“真奇怪，我的眼镜不见了！”Nhan在床下面找到了眼镜。这时候，他们听到一个很熟悉的声音，是爷爷！(Nhan zǎoshang hěn mǎhu, tā bù shuāyá, yě bù xǐ liǎn, jiù qù tǐyùguǎn bǐsài. Bǐsài de shíhou, tā pǎo de tài kuài, shòushāng le, jiǎo téng de shòu bu liǎo. Yīshēng shuō: “Tī zúqiú hěn róngyì shòushāng, nǐ zhège xīngqī bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú.” Zài yīyuàn lǐ, Nhan kànjiànle nǎinai. Nǎinai shuō: “Zhēn qíguài, wǒ de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le!” Nhan zài chuáng xiàmiàn zhǎodàole yǎnjìng. Zhè shíhou, tāmen tīngdào yí gè hěn shúxī de shēngyīn, shì yéye!)
column20: 刷刷牙 (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — 刷刷牙，刷刷牙，洗洗脸，洗洗脸。每天早上刷牙，做事不要马虎，身体好！身体好！(Shuā shua yá, shuā shua yá, xǐ xi liǎn, xǐ xi liǎn. Měi tiān zǎoshang shuāyá, zuò shì bú yào mǎhu, shēntǐ hǎo! Shēntǐ hǎo!)

column15: Leo's Big Month — This month, Leo watched lots of TV programmes: cartoons, the news and an interesting quiz. Then he got an invitation to a concert. He played a drum solo very well. Next, he joined a bike race. 'Why do you like racing?' asked Anna. 'Because it's exciting!' But on the day of the race, Leo had flu. 'You should take some medicine and rest,' said the doctor. Leo was unhappy, but his coach was kind. 'Don't worry. There's a special race next month!'

column19: Leo的一个月 — 这个月，Leo看了很多电视节目：卡通片、新闻，还有很有趣的竞猜。然后，他收到两张演出的票。演出的时候，他打鼓打得很好。后来，他参加自行车比赛。Anna问：“你为什么喜欢比赛？”Leo说：“因为很有意思！”可是比赛那天，Leo感冒了。医生说：“你应该吃药，多休息。”Leo有点儿难过，老师说：“别担心，下个月还有一个特别的比赛！”(Zhège yuè, Leo kànle hěn duō diànshì jiémù: kǎtōngpiàn, xīnwén, hái yǒu hěn yǒuqù de jìngcāi. Ránhòu, tā shōudào liǎng zhāng yǎnchū de piào. Yǎnchū de shíhou, tā dǎ gǔ dǎ de hěn hǎo. Hòulái, tā cānjiā zìxíngchē bǐsài. Anna wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan bǐsài?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn yǒu yìsi!” Kěshì bǐsài nà tiān, Leo gǎnmào le. Yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi.” Leo yǒudiǎnr nánguò, lǎoshī shuō: “Bié dānxīn, xià gè yuè hái yǒu yí gè tèbié de bǐsài!”)
column20: 看电视呀 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎) — 看电视呀，弹钢琴呀，去比赛，去比赛。生病应该吃药，每天坚持锻炼，真快乐！真快乐！(Kàn diànshì ya, tán gāngqín ya, qù bǐsài, qù bǐsài. Shēngbìng yīnggāi chī yào, měi tiān jiānchí duànliàn, zhēn kuàilè! Zhēn kuàilè!)

column14: Kiểm tra chặng 2 theo dạng Cambridge A2 Flyers (mỗi phần ≤30 phút): 1) Listening (25 phút): Part 1 nghe và nối tên (Leo – watching a cartoon / Anna – playing the violin / Nhan – doing gymnastics / Xiaomei – taking medicine / Grandpa – reading the newspaper); Part 4 nghe chọn A/B/C (5 câu về TV, nhạc cụ, thể thao, bệnh). 2) Reading & Writing (30 phút): Part 1 đọc định nghĩa viết từ (torch, concert, tent, soap, lift); Part 5 điền 1–2 từ vào truyện 'Leo's Busy Week' (5 chỗ); Part 6 trả lời ngắn: What do you watch every evening? / What instrument can you play? / Why do you like your favourite sport? / What should you do when you've got flu? 3) Flyers Nói phần 1 + phần 3 (thi bù cho em chưa thi xong ở buổi 37, 8–10 phút mỗi cặp, ghi âm): tìm điểm khác nhau giữa 2 tranh phòng khách (TV on / off, violin / drum, football / tennis, medicine / soap) và kể truyện 5 tranh 'The Camping Trip'.
column15: Leo's Busy Week — On Monday, Leo watched an interesting quiz programme. On Wednesday, he played the drums at the school concert. He played very well! On Friday, he had a bike race, but he fell over and injured his knee. The doctor said, 'You should rest and take this medicine.' Leo wasn't worried. 'No problem! I can watch cartoons this weekend!' On Sunday, Xiaomei visited him with a special present – a big puzzle. 'Thank you!' said Leo. 'You're welcome!' said Xiaomei.

column18: Kiểm tra chặng 2 theo dạng YCT4 (mỗi phần ≤30 phút): 1) 听力 Nghe (20 phút): nghe – phán đoán tranh đúng/sai (5 câu: 他正在看新闻。/ 她钢琴弹得很好。/ 他们在体育馆比赛。/ 他头疼。/ 这里不可以游泳。); nghe đối thoại – chọn tranh (5 câu). 2) 阅读 Đọc (25 phút): chọn từ điền chỗ trống (正在 / 一共 / 除了 / 危险 / 应该); đọc đoạn 'Leo忙的一个星期' và phán đoán đúng/sai (4 câu). 3) 书写 Viết (15 phút): sắp xếp từ thành câu (我 / 正在 / 做 / 作业 → 我正在做作业。/ 他 / 唱 / 得 / 很好 → 他唱得很好。/ 你 / 应该 / 吃药 → 你应该吃药。) và viết chữ Hán theo pinyin: diànshì / bǐsài / yīnggāi. 4) Thi thử YCT口试（中级）trọn đề (14 câu; mỗi em 10 phút chuẩn bị + khoảng 9 phút thi; cô là giám khảo, ghi âm từng em, chấm thang 100 điểm, đạt từ 60; trong lúc 1 em thi, các bạn làm bài 1–3 với trợ giảng; khởi động: 你会弹钢琴吗？(Nǐ huì tán gāngqín ma?)): 第一部分 听后重复 (10 câu, 3 phút): 他正在看新闻。(Tā zhèngzài kàn xīnwén.) / 她钢琴弹得很好。(Tā gāngqín tán de hěn hǎo.) / 除了钢琴以外，我还会打鼓。(Chúle gāngqín yǐwài, wǒ hái huì dǎ gǔ.) / 两张票一共两百块。(Liǎng zhāng piào yígòng liǎng bǎi kuài.) / 我对功夫很感兴趣。(Wǒ duì gōngfu hěn gǎn xìngqù.) / 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèli bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.) / 你应该去看医生。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.) / 我每天早上坚持跑步。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang jiānchí pǎobù.) / 我们的楼有电梯。(Wǒmen de lóu yǒu diàntī.) / 九月还很暖和。(Jiǔyuè hái hěn nuǎnhuo.) 第二部分 看图说话 (2 tranh, 3 phút): tranh 1 'buổi biểu diễn ở trường' – câu mẫu: 今天学校有演出。Anna弹钢琴弹得很好，Nhan打鼓也打得很好。同学们互相帮助，大家都很高兴。(Jīntiān xuéxiào yǒu yǎnchū. Anna tán gāngqín tán de hěn hǎo, Nhan dǎ gǔ yě dǎ de hěn hǎo. Tóngxuémen hùxiāng bāngzhù, dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.) / tranh 2 'Leo bị cảm' – câu mẫu: Leo感冒了，他头疼，还咳嗽。妈妈带他去看医生。医生说：“你应该吃药，多休息。”(Leo gǎnmào le, tā tóuténg, hái késou. Māma dài tā qù kàn yīshēng. Yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi.”) 第三部分 回答问题 (2 câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, 3 phút): 你喜欢什么运动？为什么？(Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng? Wèi shénme?) / 生病的时候应该做什么？(Shēngbìng de shíhou yīnggāi zuò shénme?)

They find their two cities and draw a line from the south to the north.

column5: Where's the Stadium? — A man with a violin stops Leo at the corner. 'Excuse me, how do I get to the stadium?' Leo says, 'Go straight on to the crossroads and turn left. Walk past the post office. At the T-junction, turn right. Don't take a taxi this way, it's a one-way street. The stadium is to the east of the railway station. It's quite far, so you can take a bus.' 'Thank you! I'm playing in the concert tonight. Here's an invitation for you!' says the man.

Anna follows the signs and gets there at 7 p.m. She hears drums and a violin. 'I'm not late!' she says.

column9: [Ngữ pháp: quốc tịch = tên nước + 人] 你是哪国人？我是越南人。(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Wǒ shì Yuènán rén.) / 他是印度人，他从印度来。(Tā shì Yìndù rén, tā cóng Yìndù lái.) / [Ngữ pháp: A 属于 B] 新加坡属于哪个洲？新加坡属于亚洲。(Xīnjiāpō shǔyú nǎ gè zhōu? Xīnjiāpō shǔyú Yàzhōu.)
column10: 新同学 — Leo的班里来了一个新同学。他问：“我可以坐这儿吗？”Leo说：“可以！你是哪国人？”新同学说：“我是印度人，我从印度来。”Leo看了看世界地图，说：“印度属于亚洲，越南也属于亚洲！”(Leo de bān lǐ lái le yī gè xīn tóngxué. Tā wèn: “Wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèr ma?” Leo shuō: “Kěyǐ! Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?” Xīn tóngxué shuō: “Wǒ shì Yìndù rén, wǒ cóng Yìndù lái.” Leo kàn le kàn shìjiè dìtú, shuō: “Yìndù shǔyú Yàzhōu, Yuènán yě shǔyú Yàzhōu!”)

column14: 1) Nối người với quốc tịch (dạng Flyers Listening Part 1, nối tên với tranh, 5 câu): Leo – Vietnamese / Raj – Indian / Mei – from Singapore / Bat – from Mongolia / Sara – from Africa. 2) Kéo thả tên nước vào đúng châu lục trên bản đồ: Singapore, India, Mongolia → Asia; England, France → Europe. 3) Chọn đúng (as … as), loại phương án nhiễu (4 câu): Singapore is as hot as Vietnam. (hot / empty) / Mongolia isn't as warm as India. (warm / tidy) / The capital is as big as a city. (city / crown)
column15: The Flag Day — At school, every child brings a flag. 'Where are you from, Raj?' asks Anna. 'I'm from India. I'm Indian. India is in Asia.' Mei says, 'I'm from Singapore. It's a small country, but it's as busy as a big city!' Bat says, 'I'm from Mongolia. Its capital is very cold in winter.' 'May we put all the flags on the map?' asks Leo. The teacher says, 'Yes, you may!'
column16: Where Are You From? (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — Where are you from? Tell me, please! / I'm from Vietnam, I'm Vietnamese. / He's from India, he's Indian, / She's from Singapore, in Asia, my friend. / Asia, Europe, Africa too — / Which continent? Tell me, do!
column17: Mới: 从 cóng, 亚洲 Yàzhōu, 新加坡 Xīnjiāpō, 印度 Yìndù, 欧洲 Ōuzhōu, 非洲 Fēizhōu, 蒙古 Ménggǔ, 公里 gōnglǐ, 记得 jìde | Ôn: 越南 Yuènán, 中国 Zhōngguó, 世界 shìjiè, 地图 dìtú
column18: 1) Nghe chọn tranh lá cờ (dạng YCT4 nghe, 4 câu): 我是越南人。/ 他从印度来。/ 她是新加坡人。/ 他是蒙古人。 2) Phán đoán đúng/sai (4 câu): 新加坡属于亚洲。(✓) / 蒙古属于欧洲。(✗) / 非洲比欧洲大。(✓) / 印度属于非洲。(✗) 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp bằng thẻ nhân vật: 你是哪国人？— 我是……人。/ ……属于哪个洲？— ……属于……。
column19: 国旗日 — 学校里，每个同学都带来一面国旗。Anna问：“你是哪国人？”Raj说：“我是印度人，印度属于亚洲。”Mei说：“我从新加坡来。”Bat说：“我是蒙古人，我记得蒙古离北京一千多公里。”老师说：“我们把国旗放在世界地图上吧！”(Xuéxiào lǐ, měi gè tóngxué dōu dài lái yī miàn guóqí. Anna wèn: “Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?” Raj shuō: “Wǒ shì Yìndù rén, Yìndù shǔyú Yàzhōu.” Mei shuō: “Wǒ cóng Xīnjiāpō lái.” Bat shuō: “Wǒ shì Ménggǔ rén, wǒ jìde Ménggǔ lí Běijīng yīqiān duō gōnglǐ.” Lǎoshī shuō: “Wǒmen bǎ guóqí fàng zài shìjiè dìtú shàng ba!”)
column20: 你是哪国人 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 你是哪国人？你是哪国人？我是越南人，我是越南人。他从印度来，她从新加坡来，都属于，亚洲。(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén? Wǒ shì Yuènán rén, wǒ shì Yuènán rén. Tā cóng Yìndù lái, tā cóng Xīnjiāpō lái, dōu shǔyú, Yàzhōu.)

column5: Anna's Quiz — Anna watches a quiz programme on TV. 'Which continent is Mongolia in?' asks the man. 'Asia!' says Anna. 'Is Europe as big as Africa?' 'No! Africa is bigger,' she answers. 'What is the capital of Vietnam?' 'Hanoi!' Anna gets ten points. 'Geography is interesting!' she says.

column9: [Ngữ pháp: A 属于 B] 蒙古属于亚洲。(Ménggǔ shǔyú Yàzhōu.) / 欧洲没有非洲大。(Ōuzhōu méiyǒu Fēizhōu dà.) / 河内离北京多少公里？(Hénèi lí Běijīng duōshao gōnglǐ?) / 我记得蒙古在中国的北边。(Wǒ jìde Ménggǔ zài Zhōngguó de běibian.)
column10: 竞猜节目 — Anna在看电视竞猜节目。电视里的叔叔问：“蒙古属于哪个洲？”Anna说：“亚洲！”叔叔又问：“欧洲和非洲，哪个大？”Anna说：“我记得非洲比欧洲大。”她都答对了，非常高兴。(Anna zài kàn diànshì jìngcāi jiémù. Diànshì lǐ de shūshu wèn: “Ménggǔ shǔyú nǎ gè zhōu?” Anna shuō: “Yàzhōu!” Shūshu yòu wèn: “Ōuzhōu hé Fēizhōu, nǎ gè dà?” Anna shuō: “Wǒ jìde Fēizhōu bǐ Ōuzhōu dà.” Tā dōu dá duì le, fēicháng gāoxìng.)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: be in – thuộc châu lục] Russia is in Europe and Asia. / Is anyone here from Oceania? / Let's find out about the Americas. / Did you hear that? Mongolia is to the north of China.
column5: The Class Project — The teacher asks, 'Is anyone from another continent?' Nobody answers. 'OK, let's find out about the world!' Group 1 finds out about the Americas. Group 2 finds out about Oceania. Leo's group finds out about Russia. 'Russia is in Europe and Asia. It's quite cold in the north!' Leo tells the class. Everyone wants to hear more.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "Russia for kids facts Europe and Asia"

column8: Mới: 照顾妹妹 zhàogù mèimei / 照顾自己 zhàogù zìjǐ / 在欧洲和亚洲 zài Ōuzhōu hé Yàzhōu | Ôn: 向北走 xiàng běi zǒu
column9: [Ngữ pháp: A 在 B – vị trí châu lục] 俄罗斯在欧洲和亚洲。(Éluósī zài Ōuzhōu hé Yàzhōu.) / 美洲在越南的东边。(Měizhōu zài Yuènán de dōngbian.) / 大洋洲在亚洲的南边。(Dàyángzhōu zài Yàzhōu de nánbian.) / 妈妈不在家，我照顾妹妹。(Māma bú zài jiā, wǒ zhàogù mèimei.)
column10: 看世界地图 — 妈妈去上班了，Leo在家照顾妹妹。他们一起看世界地图。Leo说：“俄罗斯在北方，在欧洲和亚洲。大洋洲在南边。”妹妹问：“美洲在哪里？”Leo说：“在东边，很远很远！”(Māma qù shàngbān le, Leo zài jiā zhàogù mèimei. Tāmen yīqǐ kàn shìjiè dìtú. Leo shuō: “Éluósī zài běifāng, zài Ōuzhōu hé Yàzhōu. Dàyángzhōu zài nánbian.” Mèimei wèn: “Měizhōu zài nǎli?” Leo shuō: “Zài dōngbian, hěn yuǎn hěn yuǎn!”)

column14: 1) Nghe và tô màu châu lục (dạng Flyers Listening Part 5 nghe – tô màu, 5 câu): Colour the Americas blue. / Colour Oceania green. / Colour Russia red. / Colour Africa yellow. / Colour Asia orange. 2) Đọc đoạn văn và điền từ (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing, 5 chỗ trống: find out / look after / remember / end / anyone): Is ___ from Oceania? / Let's ___ about Russia. / I ___ my sister. / ___ your ticket! / The hotel is at the ___ of the road. 3) Loại từ nhiễu (chọn từ không cùng nhóm): Asia / Europe / college / Africa; Russia / India / fridge / Mongolia. 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu) – trao đổi thông tin về 2 chuyến đi (cô là giám khảo; cô có thẻ 'Mei's trip', con có thẻ 'Nhan's trip'): Con hỏi: Where is Mei's trip? – To Singapore. / Which continent is Singapore in? – It's in Asia. / How does she travel? – By plane. / Who does she travel with? – Her grandma. / What does she want to see? – The big gardens. Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: Where is Nhan's trip? – To Russia. / Which continent is Russia in? – Europe and Asia. / How long is the trip? – Ten days. / Who does he look after? – His little brother. / What does he want to find out about? – Russian food.
column15: The Lost Bag — At the airport in Hong Kong, a woman can't find her bag. 'Can anyone help me?' she asks. Leo hears her. 'Where are you from?' 'I'm from Russia.' 'Let's find out where your bag is,' says Leo's dad. They look everywhere, but the bag is nowhere. Then Leo remembers: 'There's a bag at the end of the corridor!' They walk there, step by step. It's her bag! 'Thank you for looking after me,' she says.
column16: Find Out! (giai điệu London Bridge) — Let's find out where they are, where they are, where they are, / Let's find out where they are, all the continents! / Asia, Europe, Africa, Africa, Africa, / Oceania, the Americas — we remember them!
column17: Mới: 美洲 Měizhōu, 大洋洲 Dàyángzhōu, 俄罗斯 Éluósī, 照顾 zhàogù, 为了 wèile, 必须 bìxū, 香港 Xiānggǎng | Ôn: 亚洲 Yàzhōu, 欧洲 Ōuzhōu, 非洲 Fēizhōu, 记得 jìde, 公里 gōnglǐ, 从 cóng
column18: 1) Nghe và nối tên nước với châu lục (dạng YCT4 nghe, 5 câu): 俄罗斯 – 欧洲和亚洲 / 新加坡 – 亚洲 / 香港 – 中国 / 美洲 – 东边 / 大洋洲 – 南边。 2) Chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống (为了 / 必须 / 照顾): ___学中文，我每天听中文歌。/ 你___准时到。/ 我在家___奶奶。 3) Sắp xếp thành câu: 是 / 香港 / 中国的一个城市 → 香港是中国的一个城市。
column19: 找包 — 在香港的机场，一个阿姨的包不见了。她是俄罗斯人。Leo的爸爸说：“我们帮你找吧！”他们找了很长时间。Leo说：“我记得门口有一个包！”他们一直走到门口，那就是阿姨的包。阿姨说：“谢谢你们照顾我！”(Zài Xiānggǎng de jīchǎng, yī gè āyí de bāo bú jiàn le. Tā shì Éluósī rén. Leo de bàba shuō: “Wǒmen bāng nǐ zhǎo ba!” Tāmen zhǎo le hěn cháng shíjiān. Leo shuō: “Wǒ jìde ménkǒu yǒu yī gè bāo!” Tāmen yīzhí zǒu dào ménkǒu, nà jiù shì āyí de bāo. Āyí shuō: “Xièxie nǐmen zhàogù wǒ!”)
column20: 五个洲 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 亚洲欧洲，亚洲欧洲，非洲美洲，非洲美洲，还有一个大洋洲，我们都要记得，世界大，世界大。(Yàzhōu Ōuzhōu, Yàzhōu Ōuzhōu, Fēizhōu Měizhōu, Fēizhōu Měizhōu, hái yǒu yī gè Dàyángzhōu, wǒmen dōu yào jìde, shìjiè dà, shìjiè dà.)

column5: A Trip to Singapore — Bông's family is on holiday in Singapore. 'Remember to look after your brother,' says Mum. At the end of the street there is a tall skyscraper. There is nowhere to sit, so they stand and look up. 'Singapore is as hot as Vietnam!' says Bông. Her little brother takes a step and holds her hand. 'Next year, let's visit Hong Kong. It's a city in China,' says Dad.

column8: Mới: 为了学中文 wèile xué Zhōngwén / 必须准时 bìxū zhǔnshí / 必须照顾好 bìxū zhàogù hǎo / 中国的一个城市 Zhōngguó de yī gè chéngshì | Ôn: 记得 jìde
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 为了 + mục đích] 为了学中文，Anna每天看中文节目。(Wèile xué Zhōngwén, Anna měi tiān kàn Zhōngwén jiémù.) / 你必须照顾好弟弟。(Nǐ bìxū zhàogù hǎo dìdi.) / 香港是中国的一个城市。(Xiānggǎng shì Zhōngguó de yī gè chéngshì.) / 我们必须准时到机场。(Wǒmen bìxū zhǔnshí dào jīchǎng.)
column10: 去香港旅游 — Bông一家去香港旅游。妈妈说：“你必须照顾好弟弟。”为了看很高的楼，他们一直走到路口。香港是中国的一个城市，很热。Bông说：“香港和越南一样热！”(Bông yī jiā qù Xiānggǎng lǚyóu. Māma shuō: “Nǐ bìxū zhàogù hǎo dìdi.” Wèile kàn hěn gāo de lóu, tāmen yīzhí zǒu dào lùkǒu. Xiānggǎng shì Zhōngguó de yī gè chéngshì, hěn rè. Bông shuō: “Xiānggǎng hé Yuènán yīyàng rè!”)

column5: Indian Food Night — Nhan's neighbour, Mrs Patel, is from India. She's Indian. She shows Nhan how to cook Indian rice with vegetables. 'Cut the onions like this. Be careful, don't burn your hand!' Nhan cuts the potatoes. It is not as easy as it looks! At the end, the food is delicious. 'Next week, you can act as a cook in our play!' laughs Mrs Patel.

column10: 印度饭 — Nhan的邻居阿姨是印度人。叔叔去新加坡开会了，阿姨教Nhan做印度饭。阿姨说：“小心！”Nhan以为做饭很容易，可是不容易。最后，饭很好吃，Nhan说：“我以为我不会做饭，现在我会了！”(Nhan de línjū āyí shì Yìndù rén. Shūshu qù Xīnjiāpō kāihuì le, āyí jiāo Nhan zuò Yìndù fàn. Āyí shuō: “Xiǎoxīn!” Nhan yǐwéi zuò fàn hěn róngyì, kěshì bù róngyì. Zuìhòu, fàn hěn hǎochī, Nhan shuō: “Wǒ yǐwéi wǒ bú huì zuò fàn, xiànzài wǒ huì le!”)

column13: Mới: burn, cut, act, Indian | Ôn: may, continent, Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, Oceania, India, Singapore, Mongolia, Russia, capital, anyone, find out, look after, as ... as
column14: 1) Đọc và chọn câu trả lời đúng cho hội thoại (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing Part 2, 5 câu): Where are you from? (A I'm Indian. B I'm from India. C Yes, I am.) / Which continent is Singapore in? / May I come in? / Can you look after my bag? / Is Mongolia as hot as India? 2) Trò chơi 'Who am I?': con đọc thẻ gợi ý và đoán nước (Mongolia / Russia / Singapore / India). 3) Nhìn tranh nhà bếp, nói câu cảnh báo: Don't cut your finger! / Don't burn your hand!
column15: The School Play — The class is going to act in a play called 'Children of the World'. Leo acts as a boy from Russia. Anna acts as a girl from Singapore. Bông is Indian in the play. Before the play, Bông helps in the kitchen. 'Don't cut your finger and don't burn your hand!' says the teacher. On stage, every child says, 'Where are you from?' and answers. At the end, everyone claps.
column16: Children of the World (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — Where are you from, from, from? / I'm from India, I'm Indian! / Where are you from, from, from? / I'm from Singapore! / Russia is as big as can be, / Big as can be, big as can be, / Find out more and come with me, / All around the world!

column19: 学校的演出 — 同学们要演一个节目：《世界的孩子》。Leo演俄罗斯人，Anna演新加坡人，Bông演印度人。演出以前，Bông以为她会忘记，可是她记得每一句话。老师说：“你们必须互相帮助。”最后，大家都说得很好。(Tóngxuémen yào yǎn yī gè jiémù: “Shìjiè de háizi”. column20: 世界的孩子 (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — 你是哪国人，哪国人，哪国人？我是越南人，越南人。他从印度来，从印度来，她从新加坡来！(Nǐ shì nǎ guó rén, nǎ guó rén, nǎ guó rén? Wǒ shì Yuènán rén, Yuènán rén. Tā cóng Yìndù lái, cóng Yìndù lái, tā cóng Xīnjiāpō lái!)

column5: Who Am I? — Listen and guess. 'I'm from a country in Asia. It's to the north of China. It's not as hot as Vietnam. Its capital is very cold in winter.' (Mongolia!) 'I'm from a big country in Europe and Asia. Remember, it's very cold in the north.' (Russia!) 'I'm from a small country in Asia. It's as hot as Vietnam and there are lots of skyscrapers.' (Singapore!)

column10: 猜一猜 — 听一听，猜一猜：“我的国家属于亚洲，在中国的北边，冬天很冷。”（蒙古！）“我的国家很大，在欧洲和亚洲，北方很冷。”（俄罗斯！）“我的国家很小，属于亚洲，和越南一样热，有很多很高的楼。”（新加坡！）(Tīng yi tīng, cāi yi cāi: “Wǒ de guójiā shǔyú Yàzhōu, zài Zhōngguó de běibian, dōngtiān hěn lěng.” (Ménggǔ!) “Wǒ de guójiā hěn dà, zài Ōuzhōu hé Yàzhōu, běifāng hěn lěng.” (Éluósī!) “Wǒ de guójiā hěn xiǎo, shǔyú Yàzhōu, hé Yuènán yīyàng rè, yǒu hěn duō hěn gāo de lóu.” (Xīnjiāpō!))

column5: World Sports Day — Children from many countries come to the sports day. A boy from Mongolia rides a horse in a race. A girl from Russia shows how she can ski. Raj from India is good at chess. 'Is anyone as fast as Sara from Africa?' asks the teacher. Nobody! She wins the race. 'Remember this day,' says Leo. 'We are all friends.'

column10: 世界运动会 — 很多国家的孩子来体育馆比赛。一个蒙古男孩骑马。一个中国女孩表演功夫。Sara从非洲来，她跑得最快。为了比赛，她每天坚持练习。Leo以为他跑得很快，可是Sara更快！Leo说：“我会记得今天！”(Hěn duō guójiā de háizi lái tǐyùguǎn bǐsài. Yī gè Ménggǔ nánhái qí mǎ. Leo shuō: “Wǒ huì jìde jīntiān!”)

column15: The World Party — It's the end of the school year. Every child dresses as a person from another country. Leo is from Russia today. Anna is from Hong Kong. Bông is from India and Nhan is from Mongolia. 'Find out three things about your country!' says the teacher. Bông says, 'India is in Asia. It's as hot as Vietnam. Its people are very kind.' Everyone remembers the party for a long time.

column18: 1) Kiểm tra cuối unit dạng YCT4 (nghe chọn tranh, 5 câu): 他是印度人。/ 新加坡属于亚洲。/ 俄罗斯在欧洲和亚洲。/ 爸爸去香港开会了。/ 我在家照顾弟弟。 2) Điền chữ Hán (dạng YCT4 viết): 亚__ (洲) / 照__ (顾) / 必__ (须) / 记__ (得) 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô đọc câu tiếng Anh, con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung: Where are you from? → 你是哪国人？/ Singapore is in Asia. → 新加坡属于亚洲。
column19: 世界晚会 — 学年快结束了，同学们开一个世界晚会。Leo今天是俄罗斯人，Anna是香港人，Bông是印度人，Nhan是蒙古人。老师说：“为了晚会，你们必须找三个关于你的国家的小知识。”Bông说：“印度属于亚洲，和越南一样热。”大家都很高兴。(Xuénián kuài jiéshù le, tóngxuémen kāi yī gè shìjiè wǎnhuì. Leo jīntiān shì Éluósī rén, Anna shì Xiānggǎng rén, Bông shì Yìndù rén, Nhan shì Ménggǔ rén. Lǎoshī shuō: “Wèile wǎnhuì, nǐmen bìxū zhǎo sān gè guānyú nǐ de guójiā de xiǎo zhīshi.” Bông shuō: “Yìndù shǔyú Yàzhōu, hé Yuènán yīyàng rè.” Dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.)
column20: 你是哪国人 + 五个洲 (hát lại, giai điệu 两只老虎) — 你是哪国人？你是哪国人？我是越南人，我是越南人。/ 亚洲欧洲，亚洲欧洲，非洲美洲，非洲美洲，还有一个大洋洲，我们都要记得，世界大，世界大。

'Remember to look after our visitors,' Mum smiles.

column5: Bông's New Kitchen — Bông's family has a new kitchen. There is a big cooker, an oven, a fridge and a microwave. 'What do we use the microwave for?' asks Bông. 'We use it to heat milk,' says Mum. 'And the pressure cooker?' 'We use it to cook meat quickly.' Bông puts her milk in the microwave. One minute later, it's warm.

column14: 1) Nhìn tranh nhà bếp, đọc và viết yes/no (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing Part 1, 5 câu): You use a microwave to heat milk. / You use a fridge to fry eggs. / A cooker is in the kitchen. / You stir-fry vegetables in a pan. / You use a fork to boil water. 2) Nối dụng cụ với việc làm, nói câu use … to …: microwave – heat milk / pan – fry eggs / rice cooker – cook rice. 3) Chọn từ đúng, loại phương án nhiễu: You fry eggs in a (pan / belt). / Put the milk in the (microwave / bracelet).
column15: Cooking Club — It's the first day of the school cooking club. The teacher shows the class a cooker, a microwave and a rice cooker. 'What do we use to cook rice?' she asks. 'A rice cooker!' says Nhan. Then everyone makes lunch: Anna fries eggs, Leo stir-fries vegetables and Bông heats milk in the microwave. 'Turn off the cooker when you finish,' says the teacher. Lunch is delicious!
column16: This Is the Way (giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — This is the way we fry the eggs, fry the eggs, fry the eggs, / This is the way we fry the eggs, in the kitchen! / This is the way we stir-fry vegetables, stir-fry vegetables, stir-fry vegetables, / This is the way we stir-fry vegetables, on the cooker!
column17: Mới: 微波炉 wēibōlú, 电器 diànqì, 电饭锅 diànfànguō, 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng, 锅 guō | Ôn: 冰箱 bīngxiāng, 厨房 chúfáng, 用 yòng, 青菜 qīngcài, 鸡蛋 jīdàn, 鱼 yú
column18: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (dạng YCT4 nghe, 4 câu): 妈妈用微波炉热牛奶。/ 爸爸炒青菜。/ 奶奶蒸鱼。/ 我用电饭锅做米饭。 2) Nối động từ với món: 炒 – 青菜 / 蒸 – 鱼 / 热 – 牛奶。 3) Sắp xếp từ thành câu: 用 / 妈妈 / 微波炉 / 热牛奶 → 妈妈用微波炉热牛奶。; 蒸鱼 / 我们 / 炒青菜 → 我们蒸鱼，炒青菜。
column19: 做饭小组 — 今天是学校做饭小组的第一天。老师给大家看微波炉、电饭锅和别的电器。老师问：“我们用什么做米饭？”Nhan说：“用电饭锅！”然后，Anna炒鸡蛋，Leo炒青菜，Bông用微波炉热牛奶。老师说：“做完以后，要关掉电器。”(Jīntiān shì xuéxiào zuò fàn xiǎozǔ de dì yī tiān. Lǎoshī gěi dàjiā kàn wēibōlú, diànfànguō hé bié de diànqì. Lǎoshī wèn: “Wǒmen yòng shénme zuò mǐfàn?” Nhan shuō: “Yòng diànfànguō!” Ránhòu, Anna chǎo jīdàn, Leo chǎo qīngcài, Bông yòng wēibōlú rè niúnǎi. Lǎoshī shuō: “Zuò wán yǐhòu, yào guāndiào diànqì.”)
column20: 微波炉 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 微波炉，微波炉，热牛奶，热牛奶，蒸鱼炒青菜，我们一起做饭，真好吃，真好吃。(Wēibōlú, wēibōlú, rè niúnǎi, rè niúnǎi, zhēng yú chǎo qīngcài, wǒmen yīqǐ zuò fàn, zhēn hǎochī, zhēn hǎochī.)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: use + đồ vật + to + động từ] I use a pan to fry eggs. / We stir-fry vegetables for dinner. / Dad fries fish on Sundays. / What do you use to fry an egg?
column5: Dad's Sunday Dinner — On Sunday, Dad cooks dinner. He uses a big pan to stir-fry vegetables and fry some eggs. Leo helps him wash the vegetables. 'Don't stand near the pan. It's very hot,' says Dad. The dinner smells delicious. 'Dad is the best cook!' says Leo.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "how to stir-fry vegetables for kids easy cooking"
column7: Mới: 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng | Ôn: 打扫 dǎsǎo, 合适 héshì, 菜 cài, 鱼 yú, 鸡蛋 jīdàn
column8: Mới: 炒青菜 chǎo qīngcài / 炒鸡蛋 chǎo jīdàn / 蒸鱼 zhēng yú / 用锅炒菜 yòng guō chǎo cài | Ôn: 用……做…… yòng……zuò……
column9: [Ngữ pháp: chủ ngữ + 用 + dụng cụ + động từ + tân ngữ] 爸爸用锅炒青菜。(Bàba yòng guō chǎo qīngcài.) / 我们蒸鱼，炒青菜。(Wǒmen zhēng yú, chǎo qīngcài.) / 我喜欢吃妈妈炒的鸡蛋。(Wǒ xǐhuan chī māma chǎo de jīdàn.)
column10: 爸爸做晚饭 — 星期天，爸爸做晚饭。他蒸鱼，炒青菜，还炒了鸡蛋。Leo帮爸爸洗菜。爸爸说：“小心，锅很热！”晚饭真好吃，Leo说：“爸爸做的菜最好吃！”(Xīngqītiān, bàba zuò wǎnfàn. Tā zhēng yú, chǎo qīngcài, hái chǎo le jīdàn. Leo bāng bàba xǐ cài. Bàba shuō: “Xiǎoxīn, guō hěn rè!” Wǎnfàn zhēn hǎochī, Leo shuō: “Bàba zuò de cài zuì hǎochī!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "炒青菜 蒸鱼 儿童 做饭"

column1: Ngày 95. Unit 11 · Hấp và hầm
column2: Mới: steam, stew | Ôn: remember, look after, cut, burn, as ... as, history, flashlight
column3: Mới: steam fish / stew meat / for a long time | Ôn: a pressure cooker / look after
column4: [Ngữ pháp: use + đồ vật + to + động từ] We use a pressure cooker to stew meat. / Grandma steams fish for lunch. / Remember to cut the meat first. / The stewed meat is as soft as bread.
column5: Grandma's Secret — Grandma looks after Nhan on Saturdays. She puts some meat in an old grinder. Then she steams fish and stews meat in a pressure cooker for a long time. 'Remember, cut the meat into small pieces first,' she says. 'And don't burn your hand!' The meat is as soft as bread. 'What's your secret, Grandma?' asks Nhan. 'Time and love!' she laughs.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "steamed fish recipe for kids family cooking"
column7: Mới: 绞肉 jiǎoròu | Ôn: 照顾 zhàogù, 记得 jìde, 必须 bìxū, 以为 yǐwéi, 为了 wèile, 旧 jiù
column8: Mới: 绞肉器 jiǎoròuqì / 用绞肉器绞肉 yòng jiǎoròuqì jiǎo ròu / 绞肉包饺子 jiǎoròu bāo jiǎozi | Ôn: 蒸鱼 zhēng yú / 炒青菜 chǎo qīngcài
column9: [Ngữ pháp: chủ ngữ + 用 + dụng cụ + động từ + tân ngữ] 奶奶用绞肉器绞肉。(Nǎinai yòng jiǎoròuqì jiǎo ròu.) / 为了包饺子，我们先绞肉。(Wèile bāo jiǎozi, wǒmen xiān jiǎo ròu.) / 你必须记得先洗手。(Nǐ bìxū jìde xiān xǐ shǒu.)
column10: 奶奶的饺子 — 星期六，奶奶照顾Nhan。为了包饺子，奶奶用旧的绞肉器绞肉。奶奶说：“你必须记得先洗手。”Nhan以为包饺子很容易，可是他包的饺子很奇怪。奶奶笑了：“没关系，多练习就好了！”(Xīngqīliù, nǎinai zhàogù Nhan. Wèile bāo jiǎozi, nǎinai yòng jiù de jiǎoròuqì jiǎo ròu. Nǎinai shuō: “Nǐ bìxū jìde xiān xǐ shǒu.” Nhan yǐwéi bāo jiǎozi hěn róngyì, kěshì tā bāo de jiǎozi hěn qíguài. Nǎinai xiào le: “Méi guānxi, duō liànxí jiù hǎo le!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "包饺子 儿童 绞肉"
column12: Buổi dạy 48. Unit 11 · Cooking – Nấu ăn
column13: Mới: steam, stew, boil, roast, steam fish, stew meat, boil water, roast chicken | Ôn: cooker, microwave, fry, stir-fry, oven, remember, look after, as ... as
column14: 1) Nghe và đánh dấu món ăn đúng (dạng Flyers Listening Part 4, 5 câu): Grandma steams fish. / Dad stews meat in a pressure cooker. / Anna boils eggs. / Mum roasts a chicken in the oven. / Leo stir-fries vegetables. 2) Phân loại món theo cách nấu (kéo thả): boil – eggs, water / roast – chicken, potatoes / steam – fish, rice cakes / stew – meat. 3) Chọn từ đúng, loại phương án nhiễu (4 câu): Roast the chicken in the (oven / pocket). / Boil the water in a (pan / shelf).
column15: The Big Family Lunch — On Sunday, everyone cooks. Grandma steams fish. Grandpa stews meat in the pressure cooker for a long time. Dad roasts a chicken in the oven, and Mum boils eggs. 'What can I do?' asks Bông. 'You may help me stir-fry the vegetables,' says Mum. 'Remember, look after your little cousin, too!' At one o'clock, the table is full of food. 'This is as good as a restaurant!' says Grandpa.
column16: This Is the Way (verse 2, giai điệu Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush) — This is the way we boil the eggs, boil the eggs, boil the eggs, / This is the way we steam the fish, early in the morning! / This is the way we stew the meat, roast the chicken, roast the chicken, / This is the way we cook for you, Sunday in the kitchen!
column17: Mới: 绞肉 jiǎoròu, 绞肉器 jiǎoròuqì, 炖 dùn, 烧 shāo, 烧水 shāo shuǐ | Ôn: 微波炉 wēibōlú, 电器 diànqì, 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng, 锅 guō, 饺子 jiǎozi, 照顾 zhàogù, 必须 bìxū
column18: 1) Phán đoán đúng/sai theo tranh (dạng YCT4 đọc, 4 câu): 奶奶用绞肉器绞肉。/ 妈妈用锅炖肉。/ 爸爸用微波炉烧水。(✗) / 我们蒸鱼。 2) Trả lời câu hỏi: 你用什么烧水？/ 你用什么热牛奶？/ 你用什么炒菜？ 3) Điền chữ Hán: __肉 (炖) / __水 (烧) / __鱼 (蒸) / __青菜 (炒)
column19: 一家人做午饭 — 星期天，一家人一起做午饭。奶奶蒸鱼，爷爷用高压锅炖肉，妈妈用绞肉器绞肉，包饺子。Bông问：“我可以做什么？”妈妈说：“你帮我烧水，还要照顾小妹妹。”一点的时候，桌子上有很多菜。爷爷说：“和饭馆的一样好吃！”(Xīngqītiān, yī jiā rén yīqǐ zuò wǔfàn. Nǎinai zhēng yú, yéye yòng gāoyāguō dùn ròu, māma yòng jiǎoròuqì jiǎo ròu, bāo jiǎozi. Bông wèn: “Wǒ kěyǐ zuò shénme?” Māma shuō: “Nǐ bāng wǒ shāo shuǐ, hái yào zhàogù xiǎo mèimei.” Yī diǎn de shíhou, zhuōzi shàng yǒu hěn duō cài. Yéye shuō: “Hé fànguǎn de yīyàng hǎochī!”)
column20: 用什么 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 用什么，用什么，烧水呢？烧水呢？用锅烧开水，用锅炖牛肉，蒸蒸鱼，炒炒菜。(Yòng shénme, yòng shénme, shāo shuǐ ne? Shāo shuǐ ne? Yòng guō shāo kāishuǐ, yòng guō dùn niúròu, zhēng zhēng yú, chǎo chǎo cài.)

column5: The Picnic Plan — Anna and Mum are getting ready for a picnic. 'May I boil the eggs?' asks Anna. 'Yes, you may. Boil some water in the kettle first,' says Mum. Mum roasts a chicken in the oven. 'Let's find out what time Xiaomei is coming,' says Anna. She hears her phone. It's Xiaomei: 'Can your dad give me a lift at 10 a.m.?'
column6: Tìm YouTube: "boil roast fry steam cooking verbs for kids"

column8: Mới: 炖肉 dùn ròu / 烧水 shāo shuǐ / 你用什么烧水？nǐ yòng shénme shāo shuǐ? | Ôn: 绞肉 jiǎoròu / 蒸鱼 zhēng yú
column9: [Ngữ pháp: chủ ngữ + 用 + dụng cụ + động từ + tân ngữ] 你用什么烧水？(Nǐ yòng shénme shāo shuǐ?) / 我用锅烧水。(Wǒ yòng guō shāo shuǐ.) / 妈妈用锅炖肉。(Māma yòng guō dùn ròu.) / 爸爸去开会了，我和妈妈做饭。(Bàba qù kāihuì le, wǒ hé māma zuò fàn.)
column10: 准备野餐 — Anna和妈妈准备野餐。Anna问：“我可以烧水吗？”妈妈说：“可以，用电水壶烧水，小心一点儿。”妈妈用锅炖肉，还做了三明治。Anna说：“我们联系一下儿Xiaomei吧，她也要来！”(Anna hé māma zhǔnbèi yěcān. Anna wèn: “Wǒ kěyǐ shāo shuǐ ma?” Māma shuō: “Kěyǐ, yòng diànshuǐhú shāo shuǐ, xiǎoxīn yīdiǎnr.” Māma yòng guō dùn ròu, hái zuò le sānmíngzhì. Anna shuō: “Wǒmen liánxì yīxiàr Xiaomei ba, tā yě yào lái!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "你用什么烧水 中文 厨房对话"

column1: Ngày 97. Unit 11 · Công thức nấu ăn
column2: Mới: recipe | Ôn: science, history, surprise, May, no problem, cooker, microwave
column3: Mới: follow a recipe / a recipe for ... / bake bread in the oven / step by step | Ôn: boil water / roast chicken
column4: [Ngữ pháp: use + đồ vật + to + động từ] Grandma bakes bread in the oven. / This is my recipe for pancakes. / Read the recipe and follow it step by step. / We use the oven to roast potatoes.
column5: A Surprise for Mum — It's Mum's birthday in May. Leo and his sister find a recipe for a cake in a book. They follow the recipe step by step: sugar, eggs, butter and milk. Dad helps them bake it in the oven. 'Surprise!' they shout when Mum comes home. 'No problem! Cooking is like science,' laughs Leo.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "easy cake recipe for kids step by step"
column7: Mới: 烤箱 kǎoxiāng | Ôn: 认真 rènzhēn, 讨论 tǎolùn, 手表 shǒubiǎo, 暖和 nuǎnhuo, 微波炉 wēibōlú, 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng
column8: Mới: 用烤箱烤面包 yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo miànbāo / 做蛋糕的方法 zuò dàngāo de fāngfǎ / 一步一步 yī bù yī bù | Ôn: 炖肉 dùn ròu / 烧水 shāo shuǐ
column9: [Ngữ pháp: chủ ngữ + 用 + dụng cụ + động từ + tân ngữ] 奶奶用烤箱烤面包。(Nǎinai yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo miànbāo.) / 我们认真看做蛋糕的方法。(Wǒmen rènzhēn kàn zuò dàngāo de fāngfǎ.) / 我们用烤箱烤鸡。(Wǒmen yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo jī.)
column10: 妈妈的生日 — 五月是妈妈的生日。Leo和妹妹在书上找到做蛋糕的方法。他们讨论了一下儿，然后一步一步地做：用糖、鸡蛋和牛奶。爸爸帮他们用烤箱烤蛋糕。妈妈回家了，他们说：“妈妈，生日快乐！”(Wǔyuè shì māma de shēngrì. Leo hé mèimei zài shū shàng zhǎodào zuò dàngāo de fāngfǎ. Tāmen tǎolùn le yīxiàr, ránhòu yī bù yī bù de zuò: yòng táng, jīdàn hé niúnǎi. Bàba bāng tāmen yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo dàngāo. Māma huí jiā le, tāmen shuō: “Māma, shēngrì kuàilè!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "儿童做蛋糕 烤箱 中文"
column12: Buổi dạy 49. Unit 11 · Cooking – Nấu ăn
column13: Mới: recipe, follow a recipe, bake bread in the oven, step by step | Ôn: cooker, microwave, pressure cooker, fry, stir-fry, steam, stew, boil, roast
column14: 1) Đọc công thức và sắp xếp các bước (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing, 5 bước): Boil some water. / Cut the vegetables. / Stir-fry the vegetables in a pan. / Steam the fish. / Put everything on a plate. 2) Viết câu với use … to … theo tranh (3 câu): microwave / heat milk; oven / roast chicken; pan / fry eggs. 3) Trò chơi 'Chef nói': cô đọc lệnh, con làm động tác: Boil! / Fry! / Stir-fry! / Roast! / Steam!
column15: Leo's Recipe Book — Leo makes a recipe book for his class. Page one: 'Fried eggs. Use a pan to fry the eggs.' Page two: 'Steamed fish. Steam it for fifteen minutes.' Page three: 'Grandma's stewed meat. Use a pressure cooker.' Page four: 'Roast potatoes. Bake them in the oven.' His friends follow the recipes at home. 'My mum loves your recipe for stewed meat!' says Nhan.
column16: Recipe Song (giai điệu Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — Read, read, read the recipe, / Follow step by step, / Boil and fry and steam and stew, / Roast it in the oven, too! / Cook, cook, cook with me, / Use the cooker, please, / Turn it off when you are done, / Cooking is such fun!
column17: Mới: 烤箱 kǎoxiāng, 用烤箱烤面包 yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo miànbāo, 做蛋糕的方法 zuò dàngāo de fāngfǎ | Ôn: 微波炉 wēibōlú, 电器 diànqì, 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng, 绞肉 jiǎoròu, 炖 dùn, 烧 shāo
column18: 1) Nghe và sắp xếp tranh các bước làm bánh (dạng YCT4 nghe, 4 bước): 先看做蛋糕的方法。/ 再放糖和鸡蛋。/ 然后用烤箱烤。/ 最后吃蛋糕。 2) Nối dụng cụ với việc: 烤箱 – 烤面包 / 微波炉 – 热牛奶 / 锅 – 炒菜 / 绞肉器 – 绞肉。 3) Viết câu theo mẫu 用……做……: 奶奶 / 烤箱 / 烤面包 → 奶奶用烤箱烤面包。
column19: Leo的做饭书 — Leo给同学们做了一本做饭的书。第一页：“炒鸡蛋，用锅炒。”第二页：“蒸鱼，蒸十五分钟。”第三页：“奶奶的炖肉，用高压锅炖。”第四页：“烤面包，用烤箱烤。”同学们在家一步一步地做。Nhan说：“我妈妈特别喜欢你的炖肉！”(Leo gěi tóngxuémen zuò le yī běn zuò fàn de shū. Dì yī yè: “Chǎo jīdàn, yòng guō chǎo.” Dì èr yè: “Zhēng yú, zhēng shíwǔ fēnzhōng.” Dì sān yè: “Nǎinai de dùn ròu, yòng gāoyāguō dùn.” Dì sì yè: “Kǎo miànbāo, yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo.” Tóngxuémen zài jiā yī bù yī bù de zuò. Nhan shuō: “Wǒ māma tèbié xǐhuan nǐ de dùn ròu!”)
column20: 做饭歌 (giai điệu Frère Jacques / 两只老虎) — 炒炒青菜，炒炒青菜，蒸蒸鱼，蒸蒸鱼，烤箱里烤面包，锅里炖牛肉，真好吃，真好吃。(Chǎo chǎo qīngcài, chǎo chǎo qīngcài, zhēng zhēng yú, zhēng zhēng yú, kǎoxiāng lǐ kǎo miànbāo, guō lǐ dùn niúròu, zhēn hǎochī, zhēn hǎochī.)

column5: Cooking Quiz — Listen and answer. 'You use it to heat milk quickly.' (a microwave!) 'You use it to cook meat fast, and it's very hot inside.' (a pressure cooker!) 'You put water in it to boil. It is called a kettle.' 'You read it before you cook.' (a recipe!) 'Be kind and careful in the kitchen,' says the teacher. 'If you burn your hand, put it under cold water.'

column10: 厨房竞猜 — 听一听，猜一猜：“用它热牛奶，很快。”（微波炉！）“用它炖肉，很快就熟了。”（高压锅！）“用它烧水。”（电水壶！）“用它烤面包。”（烤箱！）老师说：“在厨房里要特别小心，不要受伤。”(Tīng yi tīng, cāi yi cāi: “Yòng tā rè niúnǎi, hěn kuài.” (Wēibōlú!) “Yòng tā dùn ròu, hěn kuài jiù shú le.” (Gāoyāguō!) “Yòng tā shāo shuǐ.” (Diànshuǐhú!) “Yòng tā kǎo miànbāo.” (Kǎoxiāng!) Lǎoshī shuō: “Zài chúfáng lǐ yào tèbié xiǎoxīn, bú yào shòushāng.”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: use + đồ vật + to + động từ] Chuyển ngữ sang tiếng Trung: I use a pan to fry eggs. / We use a microwave to heat milk. / Breakfast is ready! / This is a special recipe.
column5: The Secret Breakfast — Mum is ill and has to stay in bed. Bông and Leo want to make a special breakfast, but it's a secret. Leo boils water and makes tea. Bông fries two eggs on the stove and heats milk in the microwave. They follow Grandma's recipe for rice soup. 'Breakfast is ready!' they say. Mum smiles. 'You are so kind. Now I feel better than medicine!'
column6: Tìm YouTube: "kids make breakfast for mum story"
column7: Ôn: 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng, 烧 shāo, 微波炉 wēibōlú, 烤箱 kǎoxiāng | Ôn khóa trước: 特别 tèbié, 应该 yīnggāi, 小心 xiǎoxīn, 幸福 xìngfú
column8: Ôn: 用……做…… / 炒鸡蛋 / 烧水 / 用微波炉热牛奶
column9: [Ngữ pháp: chủ ngữ + 用 + dụng cụ + động từ + tân ngữ] Chuyển ngữ sang tiếng Anh: 我用锅炒鸡蛋。(Wǒ yòng guō chǎo jīdàn.) / 我们用微波炉热牛奶。(Wǒmen yòng wēibōlú rè niúnǎi.) / 早饭做好了！(Zǎofàn zuò hǎo le!) / 这是一个特别的做饭方法。(Zhè shì yī gè tèbié de zuò fàn fāngfǎ.)
column10: 特别的早饭 — 妈妈生病了，在床上休息。Bông和Leo想给妈妈做早饭。Leo用电水壶烧水，Bông在电炉上炒鸡蛋，还用微波炉热牛奶。他们用锅熬粥。他们说：“妈妈，早饭做好了！”妈妈说：“你们真好，我觉得很幸福！”(Māma shēngbìng le, zài chuáng shàng xiūxi. Bông hé Leo xiǎng gěi māma zuò zǎofàn. Leo yòng diànshuǐhú shāo shuǐ, Bông zài diànlú shàng chǎo jīdàn, hái yòng wēibōlú rè niúnǎi. Tāmen yòng guō áo zhōu. Tāmen shuō: “Māma, zǎofàn zuò hǎo le!” Māma shuō: “Nǐmen zhēn hǎo, wǒ juéde hěn xìngfú!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "熬粥 儿童 给妈妈做早饭"
column12: Buổi dạy 50. Unit 11 · Cooking – Nấu ăn
column13: Ôn cả unit: cooker, microwave, pressure cooker, fry, stir-fry, steam, stew, boil, roast, recipe, use ... to ..., bake bread in the oven
column14: 1) Kiểm tra cuối unit dạng Flyers Listening (5 câu, nghe và nối người với món/dụng cụ): Grandma – oven / Dad – pressure cooker / Bông – microwave / Leo – pan / Mum – rice cooker. 2) Viết công thức món mình thích, 4 bước (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing Part 7): First, ... Then, ... Next, ... At the end, ... 3) Phiên dịch nhí: đóng vai 'đầu bếp Hồng Kông' — cô nói câu tiếng Trung, con dịch sang tiếng Anh cho cả lớp. 4) Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu) – kể truyện theo 5 tranh 'The Secret Breakfast' (cô là giám khảo, kể tranh 1; con kể tranh 2–5): Tranh 1 (cô): Mum is ill and she is in bed. Bông and Leo have a secret plan. / Tranh 2: Leo boils water and makes tea. / Tranh 3: Bông fries two eggs and heats milk in the microwave. / Tranh 4: They follow Grandma's recipe for rice soup. / Tranh 5: 'Breakfast is ready!' Mum smiles and says, 'You are so kind!'
column15: The Class Cook-Off — The class has a cook-off. Each group must follow a recipe. Group 1 steams fish. Group 2 stir-fries vegetables and fries eggs. Group 3 stews meat in a pressure cooker. Group 4 bakes bread in the oven and boils some corn. The teacher tastes everything. 'Every group is a winner!' she says. 'Remember: be careful with the cooker and the oven.' Then they all have a big lunch together.
column16: This Is the Way + Recipe Song (hát lại hai bài của unit, giai điệu Mulberry Bush và Row, Row, Row Your Boat) — This is the way we fry the eggs, fry the eggs, fry the eggs, / This is the way we fry the eggs, in the kitchen! / Read, read, read the recipe, / Follow step by step, / Boil and fry and steam and stew, / Roast it in the oven, too!
column17: Ôn cả unit: 微波炉 wēibōlú, 器 qì, 电器 diànqì, 炒 chǎo, 蒸 zhēng, 绞肉 jiǎoròu, 炖 dùn, 烧 shāo, 烤箱 kǎoxiāng, 锅 guō, 电饭锅 diànfànguō
column18: 1) Kiểm tra cuối unit dạng YCT4 (nghe chọn tranh, 5 câu): 奶奶用烤箱烤面包。/ 爸爸用高压锅炖肉。/ 妈妈用微波炉热牛奶。/ 我们蒸鱼，炒青菜。/ 奶奶用绞肉器绞肉。 2) Sắp xếp thành câu (3 câu): 用 / 锅 / 我 / 烧水 → 我用锅烧水。; 先 / 再 / 烧水 / 蒸鱼 → 先烧水，再蒸鱼。; 烤箱 / 用 / 烤面包 / 奶奶 → 奶奶用烤箱烤面包。 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: một bạn nói câu tiếng Anh (We steam fish.), bạn kia dịch sang tiếng Trung (我们蒸鱼。). 4) YCT口试（中级）第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; con nhìn tranh, chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói một đoạn 4–5 câu): tranh 'bữa sáng bí mật' – câu mẫu: 妈妈生病了，在床上休息。Bông和Leo给妈妈做早饭。Leo用锅烧水，Bông用微波炉热牛奶，还炒了两个鸡蛋。早饭做好了，妈妈笑了：“你们真好！”(Māma shēngbìng le, zài chuáng shang xiūxi. Bông hé Leo gěi māma zuò zǎofàn. Leo yòng guō shāo shuǐ, Bông yòng wēibōlú rè niúnǎi, hái chǎole liǎng gè jīdàn. Zǎofàn zuò hǎo le, māma xiào le: “Nǐmen zhēn hǎo!”)
column19: 做饭比赛 — 同学们有一个做饭比赛。每个小组要按照做饭的方法做。第一组蒸鱼，第二组炒青菜和鸡蛋，第三组用高压锅炖肉，第四组用烤箱烤面包。老师尝了每个菜，说：“你们都是第一名！在厨房里要小心！”然后大家一起吃午饭。(Tóngxuémen yǒu yī gè zuò fàn bǐsài. Měi gè xiǎozǔ yào ànzhào zuò fàn de fāngfǎ zuò. Dì yī zǔ zhēng yú, dì èr zǔ chǎo qīngcài hé jīdàn, dì sān zǔ yòng gāoyāguō dùn ròu, dì sì zǔ yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo miànbāo. Lǎoshī cháng le měi gè cài, shuō: “Nǐmen dōu shì dì yī míng! Zài chúfáng lǐ yào xiǎoxīn!” Ránhòu dàjiā yīqǐ chī wǔfàn.)
column20: 微波炉 + 做饭歌 (hát lại, giai điệu 两只老虎) — 微波炉，微波炉，热牛奶，热牛奶，蒸鱼炒青菜，我们一起做饭，真好吃，真好吃。/ 炒炒青菜，炒炒青菜，蒸蒸鱼，蒸蒸鱼，烤箱里烤面包，锅里炖牛肉，真好吃，真好吃。

column5: Little Interpreter in the Kitchen — A chef from Hong Kong visits the school cooking club. He speaks Chinese, and the children speak English and Vietnamese. Anna helps. The chef says in Chinese, 'Steam the fish and stir-fry the vegetables.' Anna tells the class in English. Then Leo asks, 'What do you use to stew meat?' Anna asks the chef. 'A pressure cooker!' he answers. Everyone claps for Anna.

column9: [Ngữ pháp: chủ ngữ + 用 + dụng cụ + động từ + tân ngữ] 你用什么炖肉？(Nǐ yòng shénme dùn ròu?) / 我们用锅炖肉。(Wǒmen yòng guō dùn ròu.) / 先烧水，再蒸鱼。(Xiān shāo shuǐ, zài zhēng yú.) / 请一步一步地做。(Qǐng yī bù yī bù de zuò.)
column10: 小翻译在厨房 — 一个香港的厨师来学校的做饭小组。他说中文，同学们说英语和越南语。Anna帮大家。厨师说：“先蒸鱼，再炒青菜。”Anna用英语告诉同学们。Leo问：“你用什么炖肉？”Anna问厨师，厨师说：“用高压锅！”大家都说Anna是一个好翻译。(Yī gè Xiānggǎng de chúshī lái xuéxiào de zuò fàn xiǎozǔ. Tā shuō Zhōngwén, tóngxuémen shuō Yīngyǔ hé Yuènányǔ. Anna bāng dàjiā. Chúshī shuō: “Xiān zhēng yú, zài chǎo qīngcài.” Anna yòng Yīngyǔ gàosu tóngxuémen. Leo wèn: “Nǐ yòng shénme dùn ròu?” Anna wèn chúshī, chúshī shuō: “Yòng gāoyāguō!” Dàjiā dōu shuō Anna shì yī gè hǎo fānyì.)

column3: Mới: have a meeting / a team meeting / be going to + verb / meet my colleagues | Ôn: at the moment / in a minute
column4: [Ngữ pháp: be going to + động từ – dự định] I'm going to have a team meeting tomorrow. / Dad is going to meet his colleagues at 9 a.m. / The meeting is in the big room. / Are you going to meet Grandma at the station?
column5: Dad's Busy Day — Dad works in an office. Tomorrow he is going to have a team meeting at 9 a.m. 'I'm going to meet my colleagues from Singapore,' he tells Leo. 'Can I come too?' asks Leo. 'No, but after the meeting I'm going to meet you at school,' says Dad. Leo smiles. 'And then we're going to the concert. Here's the invitation!'
column6: Tìm YouTube: "be going to song for kids future plans"
column7: Mới: 打算 dǎsuàn, 同事 tóngshì, 会议 huìyì | Ôn: 开会 kāihuì, 明天 míngtiān, 除了 chúle, 讲 jiǎng, 上班 shàngbān, 年轻 niánqīng
column8: Mới: 打算做什么 dǎsuàn zuò shénme / 和同事开会 hé tóngshì kāihuì / 参加会议 cānjiā huìyì | Ôn: 上班 shàngbān / 去公司 qù gōngsī
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 要 / 打算 + động từ – dự định] 我明天要和同事开会。(Wǒ míngtiān yào hé tóngshì kāihuì.) / 你打算做什么？(Nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) / 爸爸明天上午九点参加会议。(Bàba míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn cānjiā huìyì.) / 除了爸爸，还有三个同事开会。(Chúle bàba, hái yǒu sān gè tóngshì kāihuì.) / 爸爸的同事都很年轻。(Bàba de tóngshì dōu hěn niánqīng.)
column10: 爸爸的会议 — 爸爸在公司上班。明天上午九点，他要和新加坡的同事开会。Leo问：“爸爸，开会以后你打算做什么？”爸爸说：“会议以后，我去学校接你，然后我们一起去听音乐会。”(Bàba zài gōngsī shàngbān. Míngtiān shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn, tā yào hé Xīnjiāpō de tóngshì kāihuì. Leo wèn: “Bàba, kāihuì yǐhòu nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?” Bàba shuō: “Huìyì yǐhòu, wǒ qù xuéxiào jiē nǐ, ránhòu wǒmen yīqǐ qù tīng yīnyuèhuì.”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "你打算做什么 儿童中文 计划"
column12: Buổi dạy 51. Unit 12 · Workplace / Future plans – Công việc và dự định
column13: Mới: meet, meeting, colleague, plan, task, be going to, a team meeting, make a plan | Ôn: tomorrow, next week, concert, invitation, a.m., decide
column14: 1) Nghe và nối ngày với kế hoạch (dạng Flyers Listening Part 1, 5 câu): Monday – team meeting / Tuesday – meet Grandma / Wednesday – school concert / Thursday – make a plan / Friday – task: clean the classroom. 2) Viết câu với be going to theo lịch tranh (4 câu): I'm going to ... / He's going to ... 3) Chọn từ đúng, loại phương án nhiễu (4 câu): Dad has a (meeting / tune) at 9 a.m. / My (colleague / solo) is from India. / Let's make a (plan / drum).
column15: The Office Visit — On Saturday, Bông visits Mum's office. 'This is my colleague, Mr Tan. He's from Singapore,' says Mum. 'Nice to meet you!' says Bông. On the wall there is a big plan for next week: 'Monday: team meeting. Tuesday: meet visitors. Wednesday: finish the task.' 'What are you going to do today?' Bông asks. 'Today I'm going to take you for ice cream!' laughs Mum.
column16: What Are You Going to Do? (giai điệu Frère Jacques / Are You Sleeping) — What are you going to do? / What are you going to do? / Next week, next week? / I'm going to have a meeting, / I'm going to meet my colleagues, / Monday morning, Monday morning!
column17: Mới: 打算 dǎsuàn, 同事 tóngshì, 会议 huìyì, 周末 zhōumò, 计划 jìhuà, 任务 rènwu, 下个星期 xià gè xīngqī | Ôn: 开会 kāihuì, 上班 shàngbān, 明天 míngtiān, 决定 juédìng, 年轻 niánqīng
column18: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (dạng YCT4 nghe, 4 câu): 爸爸明天要和同事开会。/ 这个周末我打算弹钢琴。/ 我的任务是打扫教室。/ 我们做一个周末计划吧。 2) Hoàn thành bảng kế hoạch tuần bằng câu 打算: 星期一我打算…… / 周末我打算…… 3) Sắp xếp thành câu: 打算 / 你 / 做什么 / 下个星期 → 你下个星期打算做什么？
column19: 去妈妈的公司 — 星期六，Bông去妈妈的公司。妈妈说：“这是我的同事，他是新加坡人。”Bông说：“你好！”墙上有一个下个星期的计划：“星期一开会议，星期二见客人，星期三做完任务。”Bông问：“今天你打算做什么？”妈妈笑着说：“今天我打算带你去吃冰激凌！”(Xīngqīliù, Bông qù māma de gōngsī. Māma shuō: “Zhè shì wǒ de tóngshì, tā shì Xīnjiāpō rén.” Bông shuō: “Nǐ hǎo!” Qiáng shàng yǒu yī gè xià gè xīngqī de jìhuà: “Xīngqīyī kāi huìyì, xīngqī'èr jiàn kèrén, xīngqīsān zuò wán rènwu.” Bông wèn: “Jīntiān nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?” Māma xiào zhe shuō: “Jīntiān wǒ dǎsuàn dài nǐ qù chī bīngjīlíng!”)
column20: 你打算 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 你打算，你打算，做什么？做什么？下个星期开会，周末做个计划，真忙啊，真忙啊。(Nǐ dǎsuàn, nǐ dǎsuàn, zuò shénme? Zuò shénme? Xià gè xīngqī kāihuì, zhōumò zuò gè jìhuà, zhēn máng a, zhēn máng a.)

column5: Anna's Plan — Anna makes a plan for next week. Monday: 'I'm going to practise the violin.' Wednesday: 'I'm going to play on the stage at the school concert.' Friday: 'My task is to give an invitation to every teacher.' Mum reads it. 'That's a good plan! You decided early, so you have lots of time.'
column6: Tìm YouTube: "my weekly plan for kids English"
column7: Mới: 周末 zhōumò, 计划 jìhuà, 任务 rènwu | Ôn: 互相 hùxiāng, 借 jiè, 弹钢琴 tán gāngqín, 决定 juédìng, 将来 jiānglái
column8: Mới: 下个星期 xià gè xīngqī / 周末计划 zhōumò jìhuà / 做一个计划 zuò yī gè jìhuà / 我的任务是…… wǒ de rènwu shì…… | Ôn: 打算 dǎsuàn
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 打算 + động từ – dự định] 你下个星期打算做什么？(Nǐ xià gè xīngqī dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) / 这个周末我打算弹钢琴。(Zhège zhōumò wǒ dǎsuàn tán gāngqín.) / 我们做一个周末计划吧。(Wǒmen zuò yī gè zhōumò jìhuà ba.) / 我的任务是打扫教室。(Wǒ de rènwu shì dǎsǎo jiàoshì.)
column10: Anna的计划 — Anna给下个星期做了一个计划。星期一，她打算弹钢琴。星期三，她要在学校演出。星期五，她的任务是给老师们送票。周末，她打算和朋友互相借书。妈妈说：“这个计划真好！”(Anna gěi xià gè xīngqī zuò le yī gè jìhuà. Xīngqīyī, tā dǎsuàn tán gāngqín. Xīngqīsān, tā yào zài xuéxiào yǎnchū. Xīngqīwǔ, tā de rènwu shì gěi lǎoshīmen sòng piào. Zhōumò, tā dǎsuàn hé péngyou hùxiāng jiè shū. Māma shuō: “Zhège jìhuà zhēn hǎo!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: be going to + động từ – dự định] I'm going to cook dinner tonight. I hope Mum likes it. / I hope it's sunny tomorrow. / Dad hopes to finish work soon. / I'm going to follow a new recipe.
column5: Leo's Dinner Plan — Mum is going to work late tonight. Leo is going to cook dinner. He finds a recipe for roast chicken and fried rice. 'I hope it's delicious,' he says. He uses the cooker and the oven carefully and heats the soup in the microwave. At 8 p.m., Mum comes home. 'Wow! I hope you cook again soon!'
column6: Tìm YouTube: "I hope song for kids wishes"

column8: Mới: 我希望…… wǒ xīwàng…… / 希望你喜欢 xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan / 跟朋友见面 gēn péngyou jiànmiàn | Ôn: 打算 dǎsuàn / 周末 zhōumò
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 打算 / 要 + động từ – dự định] 我希望明天是晴天。(Wǒ xīwàng míngtiān shì qíngtiān.) / 周末我要跟朋友见面。(Zhōumò wǒ yào gēn péngyou jiànmiàn.) / 今天晚上我打算炒饭，希望妈妈喜欢。(Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒ dǎsuàn chǎofàn, xīwàng māma xǐhuan.)
column10: Leo做晚饭 — 今天晚上妈妈要加班。Leo打算给妈妈做晚饭。他蒸鱼，炒饭，还用微波炉热汤。他说：“希望妈妈喜欢！”八点，妈妈回家了，说：“真好吃！周末我们和奶奶见面，你再做一次吧！”(Jīntiān wǎnshang māma yào jiābān. Leo dǎsuàn gěi māma zuò wǎnfàn. Tā zhēng yú, chǎofàn, hái yòng wēibōlú rè tāng. Tā shuō: “Xīwàng māma xǐhuan!” Bā diǎn, māma huí jiā le, shuō: “Zhēn hǎochī! Zhōumò wǒmen hé nǎinai jiànmiàn, nǐ zài zuò yī cì ba!”)

column14: 1) Đọc và chọn câu trả lời đúng (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing Part 2, 5 câu): What are you going to do tonight? / Are you going to register for the club? / Do you hope it's sunny? (I hope so!) / How often is the course? (Twice a week.) / Who are you going to meet? 2) Điền mẫu đăng ký câu lạc bộ (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing): Name / Age / Club: swimming, chess, music / How often? 3) Nói 3 câu 'I hope ...' về tuần tới, cả lớp đoán bạn đang mong gì. 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu) – trao đổi thông tin về 2 khóa học (cô là giám khảo; cô có thẻ 'Bông's swimming course', con có thẻ 'Leo's chess club'): Con hỏi: When does Bông's course start? – On Monday. / How often is it? – Twice a week. / Where is it? – At the sports centre. / Who is the teacher? – Mr Raj. / How much is it? – 200,000 dong. Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: When does Leo's club start? – Next Saturday. / How often is it? – Once a week. / Where is it? – In the school library. / What is he going to learn? – How to win at chess. / Is he going to register online? – Yes, he is.
column15: The Club Fair — At school there is a club fair. 'I'm going to register for the chess club,' says Nhan. 'I hope to be a winner next year!' Anna signs up for the music club, and Leo registers for the cooking club. 'What are you going to cook?' asks Bông. 'Fried rice and stewed meat. I hope everyone likes it!' says Leo. Bông signs up for two clubs: swimming and art.
column16: I Hope (giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — I hope, I hope the sun will shine, / I'm going to have a lovely time! / I'm going to sign up for a club, / Chess or music, art or sport? / I hope, I hope my plan comes true, / What are you going to do?
column17: Mới: 希望 xīwàng, 见面 jiànmiàn, 报名 bàomíng, 报名参加 bàomíng cānjiā | Ôn: 打算 dǎsuàn, 同事 tóngshì, 会议 huìyì, 周末 zhōumò, 计划 jìhuà, 任务 rènwu, 微波炉 wēibōlú, 炒 chǎo
column18: 1) Phán đoán đúng/sai theo đoạn văn (dạng YCT4 đọc, 4 câu): 妈妈要报名参加英语课。/ 英语课一个星期三次。(✗) / 周末Leo要跟奶奶见面。/ Bông希望明天是晴天。 2) Chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống (希望 / 报名 / 见面): 我___参加游泳比赛。/ 我___你喜欢。/ 周末我们___吧。 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你打算报名参加什么？— 我打算报名参加……
column19: 报名日 — 学校里有很多小组，大家来报名。Nhan说：“我要报名参加下棋小组，希望明年拿第一名！”Anna报名参加音乐小组，Leo报名参加做饭小组。Bông问：“你打算做什么菜？”Leo说：“炒饭和炖肉，希望大家都喜欢！”(Xuéxiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎozǔ, dàjiā lái bàomíng. Nhan shuō: “Wǒ yào bàomíng cānjiā xiàqí xiǎozǔ, xīwàng míngnián ná dì yī míng!” Anna bàomíng cānjiā yīnyuè xiǎozǔ, Leo bàomíng cānjiā zuò fàn xiǎozǔ. Bông wèn: “Nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme cài?” Leo shuō: “Chǎofàn hé dùn ròu, xīwàng dàjiā dōu xǐhuan!”)
column20: 我希望 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 我希望，我希望，明天晴，明天晴，周末和你见面，一起报名参加，真高兴，真高兴。(Wǒ xīwàng, wǒ xīwàng, míngtiān qíng, míngtiān qíng, zhōumò hé nǐ jiànmiàn, yīqǐ bàomíng cānjiā, zhēn gāoxìng, zhēn gāoxìng.)

column5: Mum's New Course — Mum wants to speak English with her colleagues. 'I'm going to sign up for an English course,' she says. She registers online. The course is twice a week, on Tuesday and Thursday evening. 'I hope I can speak English as well as you soon!' she tells Bông. Bông laughs. 'I'm going to help you with your homework, Mum!'

column10: 妈妈报名 — 妈妈想和外国同事说英语。她说：“我要报名参加英语课。”她在网上报名了。英语课一个星期两次，星期二和星期四晚上上课。她对Bông说：“希望我很快就能和你一样说英语！”Bông说：“我帮你做作业！”(Māma xiǎng hé wàiguó tóngshì shuō Yīngyǔ. Tā shuō: “Wǒ yào bàomíng cānjiā Yīngyǔ kè.” Tā zài wǎngshàng bàomíng le. Yīngyǔ kè yī gè xīngqī liǎng cì, xīngqī'èr hé xīngqīsì wǎnshang shàngkè. Tā duì Bông shuō: “Xīwàng wǒ hěn kuài jiù néng hé nǐ yīyàng shuō Yīngyǔ!” Bông shuō: “Wǒ bāng nǐ zuò zuòyè!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: be about to – sắp sửa] The meeting is about to start. / It's nine o'clock. I'm about to go to work. / I have already finished my homework. / Hurry! The bus is about to leave.
column5: Almost Late! — It's 8.55 a.m. Dad is about to go into a meeting. 'Have you got your computer?' asks his colleague. 'Yes, I've already got it,' says Dad. 'And the plan for the meeting?' 'Oh no! I forgot it!' The meeting is about to start. His colleague smiles: 'Don't worry, I've already got a copy here.' 'Thank you!' says Dad.
