column8: Mới: 要……了 yào……le / 已经……了 yǐjīng……le / 快要……了 kuàiyào……le | Ôn: 开会 kāihuì / 上班 shàngbān
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 要……了 – sắp … rồi] 会议要开始了。(Huìyì yào kāishǐ le.) / 九点了，我要上班了。(Jiǔ diǎn le, wǒ yào shàngbān le.) / 我已经做完作业了。(Wǒ yǐjīng zuò wán zuòyè le.) / 快点儿！公共汽车要开了。(Kuài diǎnr! Gōnggòng qìchē yào kāi le.)
column10: 会议要开始了 — 八点五十五分，会议要开始了。同事问爸爸：“你的计划带来了吗？”爸爸说：“啊！我忘记了！”同事笑了：“别担心，我已经带来了。”爸爸说：“谢谢你！我们准时开会吧。”(Bā diǎn wǔshíwǔ fēn, huìyì yào kāishǐ le. Tóngshì wèn bàba: “Nǐ de jìhuà dài lái le ma?” Bàba shuō: “À! Wǒ wàngjì le!” Tóngshì xiào le: “Bié dānxīn, wǒ yǐjīng dài lái le.” Bàba shuō: “Xièxie nǐ! Wǒmen zhǔnshí kāihuì ba.”)

column13: Mới: already, be about to, have already ... | Ôn: hope, meet, meeting, colleague, plan, register, task, be going to, sign up for
column14: 1) Nghe và viết ngày/giờ (dạng Flyers Listening Part 2, điền thông tin, 5 chỗ): Meeting day: ___ / Time: ___ a.m. / Colleague's name: ___ / Course: twice a ___ / Task: finish the ___. 2) Ghép câu với be about to theo tranh (4 câu): The bus is about to leave. / The film is about to start. / The meeting is about to finish. / I'm about to eat. 3) Chọn already hay yet (4 câu): I've ___ finished. / Have you finished ___? / She has ___ registered. / The meeting hasn't started ___.
column15: The Big Day — Today is Mum's big meeting. At 7 a.m., she has already had breakfast. At 7.30, she is about to leave, but she can't find her key. Bông finds it under a cushion. 'Thank you! I hope I'm not late,' says Mum. At 8.55 the meeting is about to start. Mum's colleagues are already there. At the end, her manager says, 'Great plan! Well done!' In the evening, Mum tells the family the good news.
column16: About to Start (giai điệu London Bridge) — The meeting is about to start, about to start, about to start, / The meeting is about to start, hurry, hurry! / I have already done my task, done my task, done my task, / I have already done my task, now I'm ready!
column17: Mới: 已经 yǐjīng, 要……了 yào……le, 已经……了 yǐjīng……le | Ôn: 打算 dǎsuàn, 见面 jiànmiàn, 希望 xīwàng, 周末 zhōumò, 任务 rènwu, 会议 huìyì, 同事 tóngshì, 报名 bàomíng, 计划 jìhuà
column18: 1) Nghe chọn tranh đồng hồ (dạng YCT4 nghe, 4 câu): 九点了，我要上班了。/ 会议要开始了。/ 公共汽车要开了。/ 我已经做完作业了。 2) Viết lại câu với 要……了: 会议 / 开始 → 会议要开始了。; 电影 / 开始 → 电影要开始了。 3) Chọn 已经 hay 要……了: 我___吃饭了。(đã ăn) / 火车___开___。(sắp chạy)
column19: 重要的一天 — 今天妈妈有一个重要的会议。七点，她已经吃了早饭。七点半，她要出发了，可是找不到钥匙。Bông在沙发上找到了钥匙。妈妈说：“谢谢！希望我不晚。”八点五十五分，会议要开始了，同事们已经到了。会议以后，经理说：“你的计划很好！”(Jīntiān māma yǒu yī gè zhòngyào de huìyì. Qī diǎn, tā yǐjīng chī le zǎofàn. Qī diǎn bàn, tā yào chūfā le, kěshì zhǎo bú dào yàoshi. Bông zài shāfā shàng zhǎodào le yàoshi. Māma shuō: “Xièxie! Xīwàng wǒ bù wǎn.” Bā diǎn wǔshíwǔ fēn, huìyì yào kāishǐ le, tóngshìmen yǐjīng dào le. Huìyì yǐhòu, jīnglǐ shuō: “Nǐ de jìhuà hěn hǎo!”)
column20: 要开始了 (giai điệu 两只老虎) — 要开始了，要开始了，快点儿，快点儿，会议要开始了，我已经准备好了，真不错，真不错。(Yào kāishǐ le, yào kāishǐ le, kuài diǎnr, kuài diǎnr, huìyì yào kāishǐ le, wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le, zhēn búcuò, zhēn búcuò.)

column5: What's Dad Going to Do? — Listen and answer. Dad has a busy week. On Monday he is going to have a team meeting. On Tuesday he is going to meet a colleague from India. On Wednesday he is going to work overtime. On Thursday he hopes to finish his task. On Friday he is going to register for a Chinese course. 'And on Saturday?' asks Leo. 'I'm going to sleep!' laughs Dad.

column12: Buổi dạy 54. Unit 12 · Workplace / Future plans – Công việc và dự định
column13: Ôn cả unit: already, hope, meet, meeting, colleague, plan, register, task, be going to, a team meeting, sign up for, be about to
column14: 1) Kiểm tra cuối unit dạng Flyers Listening (5 câu, nghe và nối người với kế hoạch): Anna – singer / Nhan – astronaut / Bông – office meetings / Leo – tour driver / Mum – English course. 2) Viết đoạn 4–5 câu 'My plan for next week' (dạng Flyers Reading & Writing Part 7) dùng be going to, hope, already. 3) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp: đóng vai ngày tuyển dụng — một bạn là quản lý nói tiếng Anh, một bạn dịch sang tiếng Trung. 4) Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu) – câu hỏi về bản thân, chủ đề dự định (cô là giám khảo, từng em): Now let's talk about your plans. What are you going to do this weekend? – I'm going to meet my grandma. / What job do you hope to do? – I hope to be a singer. / Where are you going to go next summer? – I'm going to go to the beach. / Tell me about your plans for next year.
column15: Leo's Future Plan — Leo writes a story about his future. 'When I'm twenty-five, I'm going to work in a big office in a skyscraper. Every Monday, I'm going to have a team meeting with my colleagues from India, Singapore and China. I hope to speak English and Chinese very well. On weekends, I'm going to cook for my family. I have already made my first plan: study hard!' The teacher reads it to the class.

column18: 1) Kiểm tra cuối unit dạng YCT4 (nghe chọn tranh, 5 câu): 我明天要和同事开会。/ 妈妈要报名参加英语课。/ 会议要开始了。/ 我已经做完作业了。/ 周末我打算和朋友见面。 2) Sắp xếp thành câu (3 câu): 打算 / 周末 / 你 / 做什么 → 周末你打算做什么？; 要 / 了 / 开始 / 会议 → 会议要开始了。; 已经 / 我 / 了 / 报名 → 我已经报名了。 3) Phiên dịch nhí: cô đọc câu tiếng Anh, con nói lại bằng tiếng Trung: I'm going to meet my friend this weekend. → 这个周末我要和朋友见面。 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; 2 câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 问题1：将来你打算做什么工作？为什么？(Jiānglái nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme gōngzuò? Wèi shénme?) — câu mẫu: 将来我打算当歌手，因为我很喜欢唱歌。我希望年轻的时候去很多国家唱歌。我已经报名参加音乐课了。(Jiānglái wǒ dǎsuàn dāng gēshǒu, yīnwèi wǒ hěn xǐhuan chàng gē. Wǒ xīwàng niánqīng de shíhou qù hěn duō guójiā chàng gē. Wǒ yǐjīng bàomíng cānjiā yīnyuè kè le.) / 问题2：这个周末你打算做什么？(Zhège zhōumò nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 这个周末我打算和朋友见面。我们要去公园踢足球，然后去吃面条。(Zhège zhōumò wǒ dǎsuàn hé péngyou jiànmiàn. Wǒmen yào qù gōngyuán tī zúqiú, ránhòu qù chī miàntiáo.)
column19: Leo的将来 — Leo写了一个关于将来的故事：“二十五岁的时候，我要在一座很高的楼里上班。每个星期一，我要和印度、新加坡、中国的同事开会。我希望我的英语和中文都说得很好。周末，我打算给家人做饭。我已经做好了第一个计划：努力学习！”老师给全班读了这个故事。(Leo xiě le yī gè guānyú jiānglái de gùshi: “Èrshíwǔ suì de shíhou, wǒ yào zài yī zuò hěn gāo de lóu lǐ shàngbān. Měi gè xīngqīyī, wǒ yào hé Yìndù, Xīnjiāpō, Zhōngguó de tóngshì kāihuì. Wǒ xīwàng wǒ de Yīngyǔ hé Zhōngwén dōu shuō de hěn hǎo. Zhōumò, wǒ dǎsuàn gěi jiārén zuò fàn. Wǒ yǐjīng zuò hǎo le dì yī gè jìhuà: nǔlì xuéxí!” Lǎoshī gěi quán bān dú le zhège gùshi.)

column14: 1) Thi thử Flyers Listening Part 1 (nối tên với người trong tranh, 5 câu): Anna is wearing striped pyjamas. / Leo is playing the drums. / Bông has got a torch. / Nhan is taking medicine. / Mei is watching cartoons. 2) Thi thử Flyers Reading & Writing Part 3 (đọc truyện, chọn từ điền, 5 chỗ trống): concert / invitation / warm / subject / surprise. 3) Giao nhiệm vụ dự án 'Our City Guide – 我们的城市介绍': mỗi nhóm chọn 1 khu phố, vẽ bản đồ, ghi đường đi, món ăn, người nước ngoài sống ở đó. 4) Thi thử Nói Flyers trọn đề cuối khóa (7–9 phút mỗi em; cô là giám khảo, gọi từng em trong lúc các bạn làm dự án; ghi âm và lưu vào hồ sơ BRIDGE): Phần 1 – tìm 5 điểm khác giữa 2 tranh khu phố: In my picture, the post office is on the corner. – In my picture, it's next to the stadium. / In my picture, a man is cycling. – In my picture, he's walking. / In my picture, there are three people at the bus stop. – In my picture, there are two. / In my picture, the girl is wearing sunglasses. – In my picture, she's wearing a hat with fur. / In my picture, a cook is frying eggs. – In my picture, he's boiling water. Phần 2 – trao đổi thông tin, thẻ 'Mei's cooking class' (cô) và 'Nhan's city tour' (con): con hỏi: Where is the cooking class? – Near the post office. / When is it? – On Sunday at 9 a.m. / What are they going to cook? – Steamed fish. / How much is it? – 100,000 dong. / Who is the teacher? – A cook from India. Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: Where does Nhan's tour start? – At the railway station. / What time does it start? – At 8 a.m. / How do they travel? – By tour bus. / What can you see? – The stadium and the skyscrapers. / Is it interesting? – Yes, it's wonderful! Phần 3 – kể truyện 5 tranh 'Lost in the City' (cô kể tranh 1: Bông and Mei go to the city centre for a concert.; con kể tranh 2–5): They can't find the stadium. / They ask a kind woman the way. / 'Go straight on and turn left at the corner,' she says. / They arrive at the stadium and the concert is about to start! Phần 4 – câu hỏi về bản thân: Where do you live? / How do you get to school? / What can you cook? / What are you going to do next summer? / Tell me about your city.
column15: The Time Capsule — At the end of the year, the class makes a time capsule. Anna puts in her old gloves and a photo of her tidy bedroom. Leo puts in a concert invitation and a drum stick. Bông puts in her science project about the weather. Nhan puts in the score card from his race and a medicine box ('I had flu!'). 'We're going to open it in ten years,' says the teacher. 'I hope we remember this year!'

column5: Mei's Visit — Mei is from Singapore. She is going to visit Bông in Hanoi. 'How do I get to your house?' she asks. 'Go straight on from the post office and turn right at the corner,' says Bông. That evening, Bông's family cooks for Mei: they steam fish and stir-fry vegetables. 'Vietnam is as hot as Singapore!' says Mei. 'I hope you come again next year,' says Bông. 'I've already made a plan!' laughs Mei.

column10: Mei来河内 — Mei是新加坡人，她要来河内看Bông。她问：“我怎么去你家？”Bông说：“一直走，在路口向右转。”晚上，Bông一家给Mei做饭：蒸鱼，炒青菜，还用微波炉热牛奶。Mei说：“希望明年再见面！”Bông说：“我已经打算好了，周末我们去香港旅游！”(Mei shì Xīnjiāpō rén, tā yào lái Hénèi kàn Bông. Tā wèn: “Wǒ zěnme qù nǐ jiā?” Bông shuō: “Yīzhí zǒu, zài lùkǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn.” Wǎnshang, Bông yī jiā gěi Mei zuò fàn: zhēng yú, chǎo qīngcài, hái yòng wēibōlú rè niúnǎi. Mei shuō: “Xīwàng míngnián zài jiànmiàn!” Bông shuō: “Wǒ yǐjīng dǎsuàn hǎo le, zhōumò wǒmen qù Xiānggǎng lǚyóu!”)

Nhan tells everyone about his friend from Mongolia. Bông reads her grandma's recipe. Leo says, 'Next year, I'm going to be a butterfly!' Everyone laughs, because the next course is called Butterfly. 'We have already learned so much. I hope we fly high!' says the teacher.

column18: 1) Thi thử YCT4 Đọc – Viết (sắp xếp từ thành câu, 4 câu): 一直 / 走 / 在路口 / 左转 → 一直走，在路口左转。; 属于 / 亚洲 / 新加坡 → 新加坡属于亚洲。; 用 / 奶奶 / 烤箱 / 烤面包 → 奶奶用烤箱烤面包。; 要 / 了 / 开始 / 会议 → 会议要开始了。 2) Trình bày dự án '我们的城市介绍' bằng tiếng Trung (mỗi nhóm 3 phút). 3) BRIDGE chuyển ngữ: mỗi con dịch 2 câu trong dự án của nhóm bạn từ tiếng Anh sang tiếng Trung, ghi âm vào hồ sơ. 4) Thi thử YCT口试（中级）trọn đề cuối khóa (14 câu; mỗi em 10 phút chuẩn bị + khoảng 9 phút thi; cô là giám khảo, ghi âm từng em, chấm thang 100 điểm, đạt từ 60, lưu bản ghi vào hồ sơ BRIDGE): 第一部分 听后重复 (10 câu, 3 phút): 我们坐电梯上楼。(Wǒmen zuò diàntī shàng lóu.) / 这件衣服比那件更合适。(Zhè jiàn yīfu bǐ nà jiàn gèng héshì.) / 最近天气很凉快。(Zuìjìn tiānqì hěn liángkuai.) / 上课的时候要注意老师的声音。(Shàngkè de shíhou yào zhùyì lǎoshī de shēngyīn.) / 我正在看新闻节目。(Wǒ zhèngzài kàn xīnwén jiémù.) / 你应该去医院打针。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù yīyuàn dǎzhēn.) / 一直走，在路口向左转。(Yìzhí zǒu, zài lùkǒu xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn.) / 新加坡属于亚洲。(Xīnjiāpō shǔyú Yàzhōu.) / 奶奶用烤箱烤面包。(Nǎinai yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo miànbāo.) / 会议要开始了。(Huìyì yào kāishǐ le.) 第二部分 看图说话 (2 tranh, 3 phút): tranh 1 'hỏi đường đến sân vận động' – câu mẫu: Mei第一次来河内，她想去体育馆。她问Bông：“我怎么去体育馆？”Bông说：“一直走，在路口向右转，就到了。”(Mei dì-yī cì lái Hénèi, tā xiǎng qù tǐyùguǎn. Tā wèn Bông: “Wǒ zěnme qù tǐyùguǎn?” Bông shuō: “Yìzhí zǒu, zài lùkǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn, jiù dào le.”) / tranh 2 'cả nhà nấu bữa tối' – câu mẫu: 晚上，奶奶蒸鱼，妈妈炒青菜，爸爸用微波炉热牛奶。Bông帮奶奶洗盘子。大家一起吃饭，很幸福。(Wǎnshang, nǎinai zhēng yú, māma chǎo qīngcài, bàba yòng wēibōlú rè niúnǎi. Bông bāng nǎinai xǐ pánzi. Dàjiā yìqǐ chī fàn, hěn xìngfú.) 第三部分 回答问题 (2 câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, 3 phút): 你家里谁最年轻？(Nǐ jiā li shéi zuì niánqīng?) — câu mẫu: 我家里我妹妹最年轻，她今年四岁，她很喜欢看卡通片。(Wǒ jiā li wǒ mèimei zuì niánqīng, tā jīnnián sì suì, tā hěn xǐhuan kàn kǎtōngpiàn.) / 明年你打算学什么？为什么？(Míngnián nǐ dǎsuàn xué shénme? Wèi shénme?) — câu mẫu: 明年我打算学游泳，因为游泳对身体很好。(Míngnián wǒ dǎsuàn xué yóuyǒng, yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.)
column19: 最后一天 — 今天是Cocoon的最后一天。同学们给爸爸妈妈看城市介绍。Anna用英语说怎么去体育馆，Nhan介绍他的蒙古朋友，Bông读奶奶做饭的方法。Leo说：“明年我要变成蝴蝶！”大家都笑了。老师说：“你们已经学了很多，希望你们飞得更高！”(Jīntiān shì Cocoon de zuìhòu yī tiān. Tóngxuémen gěi bàba māma kàn chéngshì jièshào. Anna yòng Yīngyǔ shuō zěnme qù tǐyùguǎn, Nhan jièshào tā de Ménggǔ péngyou, Bông dú nǎinai zuò fàn de fāngfǎ. Leo shuō: “Míngnián wǒ yào biànchéng húdié!” Dàjiā dōu xiào le. Lǎoshī shuō: “Nǐmen yǐjīng xué le hěn duō, xīwàng nǐmen fēi de gèng gāo!”)

He looks after the bookshop.' Page 3 is a recipe: 'Bông's grandma's steamed fish.' Page 4 is their plan: 'Next year, we're going to find out about Hong Kong.' They record the guide in English and Chinese for their BRIDGE portfolio.

column10: 我们的城市介绍 — Leo的小组做好了城市介绍。第一页是地图：“从车站一直走，就到体育馆。”第二页写人：“Raj叔叔是印度人，他照顾一个书店。”第三页是做饭的方法：“奶奶的蒸鱼。”第四页是计划：“明年我们打算去香港看一看。”他们用英语和中文录了下来，放进BRIDGE作业里。(Leo de xiǎozǔ zuò hǎo le chéngshì jièshào. Dì yī yè shì dìtú: “Cóng chēzhàn yīzhí zǒu, jiù dào tǐyùguǎn.” Dì èr yè xiě rén: “Raj shūshu shì Yìndù rén, tā zhàogù yī gè shūdiàn.” Dì sān yè shì zuò fàn de fāngfǎ: “Nǎinai de zhēng yú.” Dì sì yè shì jìhuà: “Míngnián wǒmen dǎsuàn qù Xiānggǎng kàn yi kàn.” Tāmen yòng Yīngyǔ hé Zhōngwén lù le xiàlái, fàng jìn BRIDGE zuòyè lǐ.)

column19: 雪人的愿望 — 欧洲的一个小农村里，孩子们堆了一个雪人。晚上，雪人看到圣诞老人和驯鹿在天上飞。雪人问：“圣诞老人，我也可以有礼物吗？”圣诞老人笑了，给他一顶红帽子和一个铃铛。早上，孩子们说：“雪人，圣诞快乐！”(Ōuzhōu de yī gè xiǎo nóngcūn lǐ, háizimen duī le yī gè xuěrén. Wǎnshang, xuěrén kàndào Shèngdàn Lǎorén hé xùnlù zài tiān shàng fēi. Xuěrén wèn: “Shèngdàn Lǎorén, wǒ yě kěyǐ yǒu lǐwù ma?” Shèngdàn Lǎorén xiào le, gěi tā yī dǐng hóng màozi hé yī gè língdang. Zǎoshang, háizimen shuō: “Xuěrén, Shèngdàn kuàilè!”)
column20: 圣诞快乐 (lời mới, giai điệu Jingle Bells) — 圣诞节，圣诞节，铃铛响叮当，圣诞老人和驯鹿，在天上飞翔！圣诞树，亮星星，礼物送给你，圣诞快乐，圣诞快乐，大家都欢喜！(Shèngdàn Jié, Shèngdàn Jié, língdang xiǎng dīngdāng, Shèngdàn Lǎorén hé xùnlù, zài tiān shàng fēixiáng! Shèngdànshù, liàng xīngxing, lǐwù sòng gěi nǐ, Shèngdàn kuàilè, Shèngdàn kuàilè, dàjiā dōu huānxǐ!)

column1: Ngày 114. Lễ hội 1 · Noel · Ông già Noel đến
column2: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Santa Claus, reindeer, snowman, stocking | Ôn: roof, sky, plane, already, hope
column3: Mới (nghe hiểu): fly across the sky / make a snowman / hang up a stocking | Ôn: be about to / already
column4: [Ngữ pháp: be about to – ôn] Santa Claus is about to fly across the sky. / His reindeer are on the roof. / We're going to make a snowman. / I have already hung up my stocking.
column5: Santa's Busy Night — It's Christmas Eve. Santa Claus is about to leave the North Pole. His reindeer fly across the sky. In Russia, children have already made a snowman. In Vietnam, Bông has hung up her stocking. 'I hope Santa finds my house!' she says. In the morning, there is a present in her stocking.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "Santa Claus reindeer story for kids"
column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞老人 Shèngdàn Lǎorén, 驯鹿 xùnlù, 雪人 xuěrén, 袜子 wàzi | Ôn: 已经 yǐjīng, 希望 xīwàng, 天空 tiānkōng, 俄罗斯 Éluósī
column8: Mới (nghe hiểu): 在天上飞 zài tiān shàng fēi / 堆雪人 duī xuěrén / 挂袜子 guà wàzi | Ôn: 要……了 yào……le / 已经……了 yǐjīng……le
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 要……了 – ôn] 圣诞老人要出发了。(Shèngdàn Lǎorén yào chūfā le.) / 驯鹿在天上飞。(Xùnlù zài tiān shàng fēi.) / 我们打算堆雪人。(Wǒmen dǎsuàn duī xuěrén.) / 我已经挂好袜子了。(Wǒ yǐjīng guà hǎo wàzi le.)
column10: 圣诞老人很忙 — 圣诞节前一天晚上，圣诞老人要出发了。驯鹿在天上飞。俄罗斯的孩子已经堆好了雪人。越南的Bông挂好了袜子，她说：“希望圣诞老人找到我家！”第二天早上，袜子里有一个礼物。(Shèngdàn Jié qián yī tiān wǎnshang, Shèngdàn Lǎorén yào chūfā le. Xùnlù zài tiān shàng fēi. Éluósī de háizi yǐjīng duī hǎo le xuěrén. Yuènán de Bông guà hǎo le wàzi, tā shuō: “Xīwàng Shèngdàn Lǎorén zhǎodào wǒ jiā!” Dì èr tiān zǎoshang, wàzi lǐ yǒu yī gè lǐwù.)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞老人 驯鹿 儿童故事 中文"

column1: Ngày 115. Lễ hội 1 · Noel · Bữa tối Giáng sinh
column2: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas dinner, Christmas card, wish | Ôn: roast, cooker, oven, recipe, colleague, invitation
column3: Mới (nghe hiểu): roast turkey / send a Christmas card / make a wish | Ôn: use ... to ... / I hope ...
column4: [Ngữ pháp: use … to … – ôn] We use the oven to roast the turkey. / I'm going to send a Christmas card to my friend in Singapore. / Make a wish! / I hope you have a merry Christmas.
column5: Christmas Dinner at Leo's — Leo's family has a Christmas dinner. Dad follows a recipe and roasts a turkey in the oven. Mum invites her colleagues from India and Singapore. Leo makes a Christmas card for each visitor. Before dinner, everyone makes a wish. 'I wish for snow in Vietnam!' says Leo. Everyone laughs.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "Christmas dinner around the world for kids"
column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 圣诞晚餐 Shèngdàn wǎncān, 贺卡 hèkǎ, 愿望 yuànwàng | Ôn: 烤箱 kǎoxiāng, 同事 tóngshì, 希望 xīwàng, 印度 Yìndù, 新加坡 Xīnjiāpō
column8: Mới (nghe hiểu): 烤火鸡 kǎo huǒjī / 送贺卡 sòng hèkǎ / 许愿 xǔyuàn | Ôn: 用……做…… / 我希望……
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 用 + dụng cụ + động từ – ôn] 爸爸用烤箱烤火鸡。(Bàba yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo huǒjī.) / 我要给新加坡的朋友送贺卡。(Wǒ yào gěi Xīnjiāpō de péngyou sòng hèkǎ.) / 我们许个愿吧！(Wǒmen xǔ gè yuàn ba!) / 希望你圣诞快乐！(Xīwàng nǐ Shèngdàn kuàilè!)
column10: Leo家的圣诞晚餐 — Leo家有圣诞晚餐。爸爸用烤箱烤火鸡。妈妈请了印度和新加坡的同事。Leo给每个客人做了一张贺卡。吃饭以前，大家都许了愿。Leo说：“我希望越南也下雪！”大家都笑了。(Leo jiā yǒu Shèngdàn wǎncān. Bàba yòng kǎoxiāng kǎo huǒjī. Māma qǐng le Yìndù hé Xīnjiāpō de tóngshì. Leo gěi měi gè kèrén zuò le yī zhāng hèkǎ. Chīfàn yǐqián, dàjiā dōu xǔ le yuàn. Leo shuō: “Wǒ xīwàng Yuènán yě xià xuě!” Dàjiā dōu xiào le.)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "圣诞晚餐 贺卡 儿童 中文"
column12: Buổi dạy 58. Lễ hội 1 · Noel – Christmas (đổi theo lịch thật: Trung thu / Halloween / 1-6 nếu cần)
column13: Nghe hiểu (không kiểm tra): Christmas dinner, Christmas card, wish, roast turkey, Christmas around the world, beach | Ôn: Oceania, Europe, Russia, oven, recipe, colleague
column14: 1) Nghe và nối nước với cách đón Noel (nghe hiểu, không chấm điểm): Oceania – on the beach / Russia – in the snow / Vietnam – at the church and in the city centre. 2) Trò chơi 'Make a wish': mỗi con nói 1 điều ước: I wish ... / I hope ... 3) Làm 'Christmas card' cho một bạn ở nước khác: Dear ..., Merry Christmas! I hope ...
column15: The Christmas Party — The class has a Christmas party. Each child brings food from a different country. Nhan brings roast chicken. Anna brings a cake from a recipe from Europe. Mei brings biscuits from Singapore. The teacher dresses as Santa Claus and gives every child a present. At the end, they sing together and send cards to their friends around the world.
column16: Christmas Bells (hát lại, giai điệu Jingle Bells) — Christmas bells, Christmas bells, ringing all the way, / Santa and his reindeer fly across the sky today! / On the beach or in the snow, all around the world, / Merry Christmas, everyone, every boy and girl!
column17: Nghe hiểu (không kiểm tra): 圣诞晚餐 Shèngdàn wǎncān, 贺卡 hèkǎ, 愿望 yuànwàng, 许愿 xǔyuàn, 烤火鸡 kǎo huǒjī, 海边 hǎibiān | Ôn: 大洋洲 Dàyángzhōu, 欧洲 Ōuzhōu, 俄罗斯 Éluósī, 烤箱 kǎoxiāng, 同事 tóngshì
column18: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (nghe hiểu, không chấm điểm): 在海边过圣诞节 / 在雪里玩儿 / 用烤箱烤火鸡 / 送贺卡。 2) Trò chơi 'Ông già Noel hỏi': 你希望要什么礼物？— 我希望要…… 3) Viết thiệp tiếng Trung gửi bạn: 亲爱的……，圣诞快乐！希望你……
column19: 圣诞晚会 — 同学们开圣诞晚会。每个人带来一个国家的菜。Nhan带来烤鸡，Anna带来欧洲的蛋糕，Mei带来新加坡的饼干。老师演圣诞老人，给每个同学一个礼物。最后，大家一起唱歌，给世界各地的朋友送贺卡。(Tóngxuémen kāi Shèngdàn wǎnhuì. Měi gè rén dài lái yī gè guójiā de cài. Nhan dài lái kǎo jī, Anna dài lái Ōuzhōu de dàngāo, Mei dài lái Xīnjiāpō de bǐnggān. Lǎoshī yǎn Shèngdàn Lǎorén, gěi měi gè tóngxué yī gè lǐwù. Zuìhòu, dàjiā yīqǐ chàng gē, gěi shìjiè gèdì de péngyou sòng hèkǎ.)
column20: 圣诞快乐 (hát lại, giai điệu Jingle Bells) — 圣诞节，圣诞节，铃铛响叮当，圣诞老人和驯鹿，在天上飞翔！海边玩，雪里玩，世界都一样，圣诞快乐，圣诞快乐，大家都欢喜！(Shèngdàn Jié, Shèngdàn Jié, língdang xiǎng dīngdāng, Shèngdàn Lǎorén hé xùnlù, zài tiān shàng fēixiáng! Hǎibiān wán, xuě lǐ wán, shìjiè dōu yīyàng, Shèngdàn kuàilè, Shèngdàn kuàilè, dàjiā dōu huānxǐ!)

column1: Ngày 116. Lễ hội 1 · Noel · Giáng sinh khắp thế giới
column2: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Christmas around the world, beach, summer Christmas | Ôn: Oceania, Europe, Russia, continent, as ... as
column3: Mới (nghe hiểu): Christmas on the beach / in the snow | Ôn: Which continent is ... in? / find out
column4: [Ngữ pháp: be in – ôn] In Oceania, Christmas is in summer. / In Russia, Christmas is as cold as ice. / Let's find out about Christmas around the world. / Children in Europe play in the snow.
column5: Christmas Around the World — Anna finds out about Christmas in other countries. In Oceania, it's summer, so families have Christmas on the beach. In Russia, it's very cold and children play in the snow. In the Philippines in Asia, people put star lights in their windows. 'Christmas is different everywhere, but it's happy everywhere!' says Anna.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "Christmas around the world for kids"
column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 世界各地的圣诞节 shìjiè gèdì de Shèngdàn Jié, 海边 hǎibiān, 夏天的圣诞节 xiàtiān de Shèngdàn Jié | Ôn: 大洋洲 Dàyángzhōu, 欧洲 Ōuzhōu, 俄罗斯 Éluósī, 亚洲 Yàzhōu
column8: Mới (nghe hiểu): 在海边过圣诞节 zài hǎibiān guò Shèngdàn Jié / 在雪里玩儿 zài xuě lǐ wánr | Ôn: 属于哪个洲 shǔyú nǎ gè zhōu
column9: [Ngữ pháp: A 在 B – ôn] 在大洋洲，圣诞节是夏天。(Zài Dàyángzhōu, Shèngdàn Jié shì xiàtiān.) / 俄罗斯的圣诞节很冷。(Éluósī de Shèngdàn Jié hěn lěng.) / 欧洲的孩子在雪里玩儿。(Ōuzhōu de háizi zài xuě lǐ wánr.)
column10: 世界各地的圣诞节 — Anna想了解世界各地的圣诞节。在大洋洲，圣诞节是夏天，很多家庭在海边过圣诞节。在俄罗斯，天气很冷，孩子们在雪里玩儿。Anna说：“每个地方的圣诞节都不一样，可是大家都很快乐！”(Anna xiǎng liǎojiě shìjiè gèdì de Shèngdàn Jié. Zài Dàyángzhōu, Shèngdàn Jié shì xiàtiān, hěn duō jiātíng zài hǎibiān guò Shèngdàn Jié. Zài Éluósī, tiānqì hěn lěng, háizimen zài xuě lǐ wánr. Anna shuō: “Měi gè dìfang de Shèngdàn Jié dōu bù yīyàng, kěshì dàjiā dōu hěn kuàilè!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "世界各地 圣诞节 儿童"

column1: Ngày 117. Lễ hội 2 · Tết · Tết đến rồi
column2: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): Lunar New Year, lucky money, red envelope, peach blossom, fireworks | Ôn: already, hope, family, January, February
column3: Mới (nghe hiểu): Happy New Year! / give lucky money / watch the fireworks | Ôn: be about to / be going to
column4: [Ngữ pháp: be about to – ôn] Lunar New Year is about to come. / Grandma gives me lucky money in a red envelope. / We're going to watch the fireworks at midnight. / Happy New Year!
column5: Tết Is Coming — Lunar New Year is about to come. Bông's family has already bought a peach blossom tree. Grandma has red envelopes with lucky money for the children. 'At midnight, we're going to watch the fireworks,' says Dad. 'I hope this year is a happy year for everyone!' says Bông. 'Happy New Year!'
column6: Tìm YouTube: "Lunar New Year for kids Tet Vietnam lucky money"
column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 春节 Chūn Jié, 红包 hóngbāo, 桃花 táohuā, 烟花 yānhuā | Ôn: 已经 yǐjīng, 希望 xīwàng, 一月 yīyuè, 二月 èryuè, 家人 jiārén
column8: Mới (nghe hiểu): 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè / 给红包 gěi hóngbāo / 看烟花 kàn yānhuā | Ôn: 要……了 yào……le / 打算 dǎsuàn
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 要……了 – ôn] 春节要到了。(Chūn Jié yào dào le.) / 奶奶给我红包。(Nǎinai gěi wǒ hóngbāo.) / 晚上十二点我们打算看烟花。(Wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn wǒmen dǎsuàn kàn yānhuā.) / 新年快乐！(Xīnnián kuàilè!)
column10: 春节要到了 — 春节要到了。Bông家已经买了桃花。奶奶准备了很多红包给孩子们。爸爸说：“晚上十二点我们去看烟花。”Bông说：“希望新的一年大家都快乐！新年快乐！”(Chūn Jié yào dào le. Bông jiā yǐjīng mǎi le táohuā. Nǎinai zhǔnbèi le hěn duō hóngbāo gěi háizimen. Bàba shuō: “Wǎnshang shí'èr diǎn wǒmen qù kàn yānhuā.” Bông shuō: “Xīwàng xīn de yī nián dàjiā dōu kuàilè! Xīnnián kuàilè!”)
column11: Tìm YouTube: "春节 儿童中文 红包 烟花"
column12: Buổi dạy 59. Lễ hội 2 · Tết – Lunar New Year (đổi theo lịch thật nếu cần)
column13: Nghe hiểu (không kiểm tra): Lunar New Year, lucky money, red envelope, peach blossom, fireworks, banh chung, New Year's Eve, family dinner, Happy New Year! | Ôn: clean, tidy, boil, already, be about to
column14: 1) Nghe và sắp xếp tranh việc chuẩn bị Tết (nghe hiểu, không chấm điểm): clean the house / buy a peach blossom / boil banh chung / have a family dinner / watch the fireworks. 2) Trò chơi 'Lì xì may mắn': mỗi bao lì xì có 1 câu hỏi ôn khóa: How do you get to school? / Where are you from? / What do you use to boil water? / What are you going to do at Tết? 3) Con nói 2 câu về Tết nhà mình: At Tết, we ... / I hope ...
column15: The Little Firework — On New Year's Eve, a little firework is about to go up into the sky. 'I'm too small. Nobody can see me,' it says sadly. At midnight, it flies up with the big fireworks. Bông looks up and points: 'Look! That little red one is my favourite!' The little firework is very happy. 'Happy New Year!' it shouts in the sky.
column16: Happy New Year (lời mới, giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — Happy New Year, everyone! / Peach blossom and lots of fun! / Lucky money, red and bright, / Fireworks shining in the night! / Happy New Year, everyone, / Tết is here, the year's begun!
column17: Nghe hiểu (không kiểm tra): 春节 Chūn Jié, 红包 hóngbāo, 桃花 táohuā, 烟花 yānhuā, 粽子 zòngzi, 除夕 Chúxī, 年夜饭 niányèfàn, 春联 chūnlián, 新年快乐 xīnnián kuàilè | Ôn: 打扫 dǎsǎo, 干净 gānjìng, 换 huàn, 已经 yǐjīng, 要……了
column18: 1) Nghe chỉ tranh (nghe hiểu, không chấm điểm): 红包 / 桃花 / 烟花 / 春联 / 年夜饭。 2) Trò chơi 'Lì xì may mắn' bằng tiếng Trung: 你怎么去学校？/ 你是哪国人？/ 你用什么烧水？/ 春节你打算做什么？ 3) Viết chữ 福 fú và một lời chúc lên thiệp đỏ: 新年快乐！
column19: 小烟花 — 除夕晚上，一个小烟花要飞上天了。它说：“我太小了，没有人看得见我。”十二点的时候，它和大烟花一起飞上天。Bông看着天空说：“看！那个红色的小烟花，我最喜欢！”小烟花很高兴，在天上说：“新年快乐！”(Chúxī wǎnshang, yī gè xiǎo yānhuā yào fēi shàng tiān le. Tā shuō: “Wǒ tài xiǎo le, méiyǒu rén kàn de jiàn wǒ.” Shí'èr diǎn de shíhou, tā hé dà yānhuā yīqǐ fēi shàng tiān. Bông kàn zhe tiānkōng shuō: “Kàn! Nà gè hóngsè de xiǎo yānhuā, wǒ zuì xǐhuan!” Xiǎo yānhuā hěn gāoxìng, zài tiān shàng shuō: “Xīnnián kuàilè!”)
column20: 新年快乐 (lời mới, giai điệu 两只老虎) — 新年快乐，新年快乐，红包红，桃花开，大家一起放烟花，一家人吃年夜饭，真幸福，真幸福。(Xīnnián kuàilè, xīnnián kuàilè, hóngbāo hóng, táohuā kāi, dàjiā yīqǐ fàng yānhuā, yī jiā rén chī niányèfàn, zhēn xìngfú, zhēn xìngfú.) (Nghe thêm: 新年好)

column1: Ngày 118. Lễ hội 2 · Tết · Chuẩn bị đón Tết
column2: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): banh chung (square sticky rice cake), New Year's Eve, family dinner | Ôn: clean, tidy, new clothes, boil, cook, recipe
column3: Mới (nghe hiểu): clean the house / wear new clothes / boil banh chung | Ôn: use ... to ... / for a long time
column4: [Ngữ pháp: use … to … – ôn] We clean and tidy the house before Tết. / Grandpa uses a big pot to boil banh chung for ten hours. / On New Year's Eve, we have a big family dinner. / I'm going to wear my new clothes.
column5: Getting Ready for Tết — The day before Tết, everyone is busy. Mum and Bông clean the house and tidy the living room. Grandpa boils banh chung in a big pot for a long time. Dad puts the peach blossom near the door. On New Year's Eve, the family has a big dinner together. Bông wears her new red dress. 'I'm so happy!' she says.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "making banh chung Tet for kids"
column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 粽子 zòngzi (bánh chưng), 除夕 Chúxī, 年夜饭 niányèfàn, 春联 chūnlián | Ôn: 打扫 dǎsǎo, 干净 gānjìng, 换 huàn, 新衣服 xīn yīfu, 炖 dùn, 蒸 zhēng
column8: Mới (nghe hiểu): 打扫房间 dǎsǎo fángjiān / 贴春联 tiē chūnlián / 吃年夜饭 chī niányèfàn | Ôn: 用……做…… / 换新衣服 huàn xīn yīfu
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 用 + dụng cụ + động từ – ôn] 春节以前，我们把家打扫得很干净。(Chūn Jié yǐqián, wǒmen bǎ jiā dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.) / 爷爷用大锅煮粽子。(Yéye yòng dà guō zhǔ zòngzi.) / 除夕晚上，我们一起吃年夜饭。(Chúxī wǎnshang, wǒmen yīqǐ chī niányèfàn.) / 我要换新衣服。(Wǒ yào huàn xīn yīfu.)
column10: 准备过年 — 春节前一天，大家都很忙。妈妈和Bông打扫房间，家里很干净。爷爷用大锅煮粽子，煮了很长时间。爸爸在门口贴春联。除夕晚上，一家人一起吃年夜饭。Bông换上了新衣服，她说：“我真幸福！”(Chūn Jié qián yī tiān, dàjiā dōu hěn máng. Māma hé Bông dǎsǎo fángjiān, jiā lǐ hěn gānjìng. Yéye yòng dà guō zhǔ zòngzi, zhǔ le hěn cháng shíjiān. Bàba zài ménkǒu tiē chūnlián. Chúxī wǎnshang, yī jiā rén yīqǐ chī niányèfàn. Bông huàn shàng le xīn yīfu, tā shuō: “Wǒ zhēn xìngfú!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: I hope … – ôn] I hope you have good health this year. / Good luck in your new school year! / We're going to visit our grandparents on the first day of Tết. / I'm going to meet my cousins.
column5: New Year Wishes — On the first day of Tết, Bông's family visits Grandma and Grandpa. 'I wish you good health and a long life!' says Bông. Grandma smiles and gives her a red envelope. Then Bông meets her cousins. 'What are your plans for this year?' asks her cousin. 'I'm going to study hard. I hope to go to Butterfly class!' says Bông.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "Lunar New Year greetings English for kids good health good luck"
column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 拜年 bàinián, 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái, 身体健康 shēntǐ jiànkāng, 万事如意 wànshì rúyì | Ôn: 希望 xīwàng, 见面 jiànmiàn, 计划 jìhuà, 亲戚 qīnqi, 健康 jiànkāng
column8: Mới (nghe hiểu): 给爷爷奶奶拜年 gěi yéye nǎinai bàinián / 祝你身体健康 zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng / 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái | Ôn: 我希望…… / 打算
column9: [Ngữ pháp: 祝 / 希望 – lời chúc] 祝你身体健康！(Zhù nǐ shēntǐ jiànkāng!) / 恭喜发财，万事如意！(Gōngxǐ fācái, wànshì rúyì!) / 春节第一天，我们去给爷爷奶奶拜年。(Chūn Jié dì yī tiān, wǒmen qù gěi yéye nǎinai bàinián.) / 我要和亲戚们见面。(Wǒ yào hé qīnqimen jiànmiàn.)
column10: 拜年 — 春节第一天，Bông一家去给爷爷奶奶拜年。Bông说：“祝爷爷奶奶身体健康，万事如意！”奶奶笑着给她一个红包。然后Bông和亲戚们见面。表哥问：“今年你有什么计划？”Bông说：“我打算努力学习，希望明年上Butterfly班！”(Chūn Jié dì yī tiān, Bông yī jiā qù gěi yéye nǎinai bàinián. Bông shuō: “Zhù yéye nǎinai shēntǐ jiànkāng, wànshì rúyì!” Nǎinai xiào zhe gěi tā yī gè hóngbāo. Ránhòu Bông hé qīnqimen jiànmiàn. Biǎogē wèn: “Jīnnián nǐ yǒu shénme jìhuà?” Bông shuō: “Wǒ dǎsuàn nǔlì xuéxí, xīwàng míngnián shàng Butterfly bān!”)

column12: Buổi dạy 60. Lễ hội 2 · Tết – Lunar New Year (đổi theo lịch thật nếu cần)
column13: Nghe hiểu (không kiểm tra): New Year wishes, good health, good luck, visit relatives, dragon dance, lantern, dumplings, Chinese New Year | Ôn: hope, meet, plan, China, Asia, Hong Kong, Singapore
column14: 1) Nghe và nối người với lời chúc (nghe hiểu, không chấm điểm): Bông – good health / Leo – good luck / Anna – a happy new year / Nhan – lots of lucky money. 2) Trò chơi 'Múa lân – dragon line': cả lớp xếp hàng, mỗi con nói 1 lời chúc mới được nối vào 'con rồng': I wish you good health! / I hope you ... 3) So sánh Tết Việt Nam và Tết Trung Quốc (kéo thả vào 2 cột): banh chung, dumplings, peach blossom, red lanterns, dragon dance, lucky money.
column15: The Dragon Dance — On the last day of the holiday, there is a dragon dance in the city centre. The dragon is long and red and gold. It dances to the drums. Leo and Bông give it a red envelope. 'Good luck for the new year!' they say. Xiaomei watches on a video call from China. 'We have the same dragon dance here!' she says. 'Happy New Year to all our friends around the world!'
column16: Happy New Year (hát lại, giai điệu Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star) — Happy New Year, everyone! / Dragon dancing, drums and fun! / Good health and good luck to you, / Happy wishes, old and new! / Happy New Year, everyone, / Tết is here, the year's begun!
column17: Nghe hiểu (không kiểm tra): 拜年 bàinián, 恭喜发财 gōngxǐ fācái, 身体健康 shēntǐ jiànkāng, 万事如意 wànshì rúyì, 舞龙 wǔlóng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 包饺子 bāo jiǎozi | Ôn: 希望 xīwàng, 见面 jiànmiàn, 计划 jìhuà, 中国 Zhōngguó, 亚洲 Yàzhōu, 香港 Xiānggǎng
column18: 1) Nghe chọn tranh (nghe hiểu, không chấm điểm): 拜年 / 舞龙 / 灯笼 / 包饺子 / 红包。 2) Trò chơi 'Nói lời chúc': con bốc thẻ, nói to lời chúc bằng tiếng Trung: 恭喜发财！/ 身体健康！/ 万事如意！/ 新年快乐！ 3) So sánh Tết hai nước, nói câu với 一样 / 不一样: 越南的春节和中国的春节一样快乐。
column19: 舞龙 — 假期的最后一天，城市中心有舞龙。龙很长，是红色和金色的，跟着鼓的声音跳舞。Leo和Bông给龙一个红包，说：“恭喜发财，新年快乐！”Xiaomei在中国用手机看，她说：“我们这儿也有一样的舞龙！祝世界各地的朋友新年快乐！”(Jiàqī de zuìhòu yī tiān, chéngshì zhōngxīn yǒu wǔlóng. Lóng hěn cháng, shì hóngsè hé jīnsè de, gēn zhe gǔ de shēngyīn tiàowǔ. Leo hé Bông gěi lóng yī gè hóngbāo, shuō: “Gōngxǐ fācái, xīnnián kuàilè!” Xiaomei zài Zhōngguó yòng shǒujī kàn, tā shuō: “Wǒmen zhèr yě yǒu yīyàng de wǔlóng! Zhù shìjiè gèdì de péngyou xīnnián kuàilè!”)
column20: 恭喜恭喜 (lời mới, giai điệu Frère Jacques / 两只老虎) — 恭喜发财，恭喜发财，身体健康，身体健康，大家一起拜年，万事如意，新年快乐，新年好！(Gōngxǐ fācái, gōngxǐ fācái, shēntǐ jiànkāng, shēntǐ jiànkāng, dàjiā yīqǐ bàinián, wànshì rúyì, xīnnián kuàilè, xīnnián hǎo!) (Nghe thêm: 新年好)

column1: Ngày 120. Lễ hội 2 · Tết · Tết ở Việt Nam và Trung Quốc
column2: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): dragon dance, lantern, dumplings, Chinese New Year | Ôn: China, Vietnam, Asia, Hong Kong, Singapore, as ... as
column3: Mới (nghe hiểu): watch the dragon dance / hang up red lanterns / make dumplings | Ôn: Which continent is ... in? / find out
column4: [Ngữ pháp: so sánh bằng as … as – ôn] In China, people make dumplings at New Year. / In Hong Kong and Singapore, people watch the dragon dance. / Tết in Vietnam is as happy as New Year in China. / Let's find out about New Year in Asia.
column5: Two New Years — Xiaomei calls Bông from China. 'In my city, we hang up red lanterns and make dumplings,' she says. 'We watch the dragon dance in the street!' Bông says, 'In Vietnam, we eat banh chung and give lucky money.' 'Our New Years are different, but they're as happy as each other!' says Xiaomei. 'Happy New Year, Bông!' 'Happy New Year, Xiaomei!'

column7: Mới (nghe hiểu, không kiểm tra): 舞龙 wǔlóng, 灯笼 dēnglong, 包饺子 bāo jiǎozi, 中国新年 Zhōngguó xīnnián | Ôn: 中国 Zhōngguó, 越南 Yuènán, 亚洲 Yàzhōu, 香港 Xiānggǎng, 新加坡 Xīnjiāpō, 一样 yīyàng

column9: [Ngữ pháp: 和……一样 – ôn] 在中国，过年的时候大家包饺子。(Zài Zhōngguó, guònián de shíhou dàjiā bāo jiǎozi.) / 在香港和新加坡，大家看舞龙。(Zài Xiānggǎng hé Xīnjiāpō, dàjiā kàn wǔlóng.) / 越南的春节和中国的春节一样快乐。(Yuènán de Chūn Jié hé Zhōngguó de Chūn Jié yīyàng kuàilè.)
column10: 两个新年 — Xiaomei从中国给Bông打电话：“在我的城市，大家挂红灯笼，包饺子，还在街上看舞龙！”Bông说：“在越南，我们吃粽子，给红包。”Xiaomei说：“我们的新年不一样，可是一样快乐！”她们一起说：“新年快乐！”(Xiaomei cóng Zhōngguó gěi Bông dǎ diànhuà: “Zài wǒ de chéngshì, dàjiā guà hóng dēnglong, bāo jiǎozi, hái zài jiē shàng kàn wǔlóng!” Bông shuō: “Zài Yuènán, wǒmen chī zòngzi, gěi hóngbāo.” Xiaomei shuō: “Wǒmen de xīnnián bù yīyàng, kěshì yīyàng kuàilè!” Tāmen yīqǐ shuō: “Xīnnián kuàilè!”)
